Commentary_Text: Abhinandan Singh to Aniket Verma, B0$, oh he got into such a great position! Abhinandan bashes it on a short of length and Aniket pounces! His weight is on the back foot as he pulls it for a flat six over midwicket. Was barely a short-arm jab but the timing was awesome

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Abhinandan Singh to Aniket Verma, no run, cracking yorker around off, squeezed to backward point

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Abhinandan Singh to Aniket Verma, 1 run, this time he gets rushed by the short ball. It zips through, hurries onto him and he gets it high on the bat while going for the pull. It's miscued in the air but lands safely wide of deep midwicket

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Abhinandan Singh to Ishan Kishan, B0$, B1$ Just another level from Kishan! Angling away outside off, back of a length, he opens the face and carves it over short third. Flies over the fielder and then over the ropes

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Abhinandan Singh to Ishan Kishan, B0$ Caught by Phil Salt!! Phil Salt, you beauty! It needed something special to get rid of Kishan tonight and he has produced just that. A one-handed screamer running across at the point boundary when the ball seemed destined for the ropes. Full toss outside off, Kishan reaches out, opens the face and slices it in the air. It's well wide of Salt who charges to his right before reaching out one-handed at full stretch. Incredible work. B1$,

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Romario Shepherd to Aniket Verma, B0$, makes this look so effortless! Back of a length, pace off perhaps and it sits up around the waist on middle and leg. From there it's all about the elegance of Aniket. Swivels across beautifully and pulls it over fine leg without going too hard. Pure timing!

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Romario Shepherd to Aniket Verma, 1 run, tucked away into the on-side

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Romario Shepherd to Harsh Dubey, 1 run, close to the blockhole just outside off, sliced through point

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Romario Shepherd to Aniket Verma, 1 run, dug in short just outside off, pace off, Aniket pulls it to deep square leg

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Romario Shepherd to Harsh Dubey, B0$, slower bumper angled away outside off, left alone by Dubey and the umpire reckons it's outside the marker

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Romario Shepherd to Harsh Dubey, 2 runs, short of length outside off, pace off again and Dubey drags the pull shot through midwicket. It's in the gap and he's back for two

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Romario Shepherd to Harsh Dubey, B0$ Caught by Devdutt Padikkal!! Looks like Shepherd has outsmarted Dubey here. He shuffled across the stumps premeditatedly, probably expecting the line to be wide. But what he got was a very full ball on leg stump. Flicks it in the air and finds the fielder at fine leg. B1$,

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Aniket Verma, 2 runs, pace off looks like the way to go in these last few overs for RCB. Slower one outside off, back of a length and Aniket cuts it to sweeper cover

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Aniket Verma, B0$, the slower bouncer from Bhuvi and it's been ramped over the keeper. Aniket initially took a couple of steps down the pitch, which may have prompted Bhuvi to go short. But he still managed to adjust so well

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Aniket Verma, 1 run, B0$ Ran in from long-on, got to it but the ball burst right through his hands and landed on the thigh. He looks surprised more than anything. Was full in the slot, Aniket tried a no-look shot but miscued it high up. Lucky to get away!

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Harshal Patel, no run, short of length outside off , pace off, Harshal punches it to cover

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Harshal Patel, B0$ Caught by Devdutt Padikkal!! Straight down the throat of Padikkal at long-off. No mistake from him and Harshal has to go. Short of length outside off, he tries lofting off the back foot, not an easy shot and there's not enough on it to clear the ropes. The wickets keep tumbling. B1$,

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to David Payne, 1 run, pace on this time, good length at the stumps, Payne knocks it down to long-off

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Romario Shepherd to David Payne, 1 run, finds the blockhole, Payne can't do much except squeeze it down to long-on

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Romario Shepherd to Aniket Verma, B0$, massive hit down the ground! In the slot around off, he gets under it and whacks it over long-on. Nice stable base to go with a hefty swing

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Romario Shepherd to Aniket Verma, B0$, tries the slower short ball this time but it's all the same for Aniket who spots it early, waits for it and plays the upper-cut to perfection. Almost goes all the way over backward point

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Romario Shepherd to Aniket Verma, B0$, not great bowling. Again in the slot, misses the yorker by a long way and Aniket takes full toll. Giving SRH just the finish they want. Smashes it down the ground for six more

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Romario Shepherd to Aniket Verma, no run, review taken by RCB for a wide call! It's full and wide, Aniket tries a reverse-scoop but misses out. He had walked across the stumps and was standing well outside off when the ball was released. The revised wide marker has moved accordingly, and it's well inside the line according to ball-tracking. Good review!

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Romario Shepherd to Aniket Verma, B0$ Caught by Virat Kohli!! Was he caught in two minds? Looked like a very half-hearted chip down the ground. Was probably thinking if he should take a single to keep strike or go for the big hit. Ended up chipping it to long-off. Was full in the slot, there to be punished, but it results in his dismissal. Simple catch for Kohli at long-off. Aniket has a smile on his face as he walks off. B1$,

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to David Payne, 2 runs, keeps it wide outside off, Payne goes after it and gets it away in the gap through point

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to David Payne, 2 runs, again wide outside off, Payne slices it wide of sweeper cover, back for two more

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to David Payne, leg byes, 1 run, now the yorker angled back in, catches Payne by surprise, his head falls over and he's hit on the pad. Was missing leg!

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Jaydev Unadkat, 2 runs, full and straight, driven firmly down the ground and long-off does well to cut it off

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Jaydev Unadkat, no run, 133kph, nails the yorker at the stumps, Unadkat squeezes it back down the pitch

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Jaydev Unadkat, 2 runs, close to the blockhole on off, Unadkat can't get under it but he drives wide of long-off and is back for two. Very poor throw from the fielder there. Should've been a run-out but the throw is so wide

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Phil Salt, no run, short of a length around off, Philip Salt defends it into the off-side

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Phil Salt, no run, a mix-up between the two batters, but no harm done in the end. This was punched towards cover-point by Philip Salt and the fielder stationed there stopped it with a dive to his right. Salt is sent back by Kohli, and it was the right call as the fielder managed to score a direct-hit at the keeper's end. Salt manages to get back in

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Phil Salt, B0$, opens his account with a rollicking boundary! Back of a length outside off, shaping away form the batter, Philip Salt plays it late, carving it through backward point as the ball races away to the fence in a jiffy

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Phil Salt, no run, pitched up by the bowler around middle and leg, hint of swing as Philip Salt squeezes it towards the fielder at mid-on

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Phil Salt, B0$, B1$ Slight width on offer outside off, Philip Salt makes it count by smashing this through covers for the second boundary of the over. No need to run for those. Nitish Kumar Reddy has a disappointed look on his face

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Phil Salt, leg byes, 1 run, drifting down the leg-side, this one clips Philip Salt's pads and rolls towards the left-side of the keeper. They take a leg bye to end the over

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Jaydev Unadkat to Phil Salt, B0$ Caught by Heinrich Klaasen!! Almost a collision between the two fielders. Jaydev Unadkat strikes in his first over. A length delivery outside off and Philip Salt looks to take him. Takes the aerial route by swinging hard, but he miscues it towards mid-off. Klaasen calls for it and charges forward to take it. There was another fielder going for the catch who was charging across from cover, but luckily they don't collide, and it's Klaasen who completes the formalities. His shout was pretty loud, but probably wasn't clear due to the background noise. B1$

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Jaydev Unadkat to Devdutt Padikkal, B0$, what a stylish shot to open his account! On the pads and Devdutt Padikkal has flicked this over deep backward square leg for half-a-dozen. A perfect shot to get going

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Jaydev Unadkat to Devdutt Padikkal, 1 run, nudged past the bowler towards mid-on for one

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Jaydev Unadkat to Virat Kohli, no run, Jaydev Unadkat goes short from round the wicket, Virat Kohli rides the bounce and pats it down the pitch

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Jaydev Unadkat to Virat Kohli, B0$, Virat Kohli opens his account with a boundary as well. All the RCB batters have opened their respective accounts with a boundary or six in this run chase. This was a length delivery and Virat Kohli frees his arms. Slices this over wide mid-off and just manages to clear the infield, enough to fetch him four runs

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Jaydev Unadkat to Virat Kohli, 1 run, taps this towards cover with soft hands for a single

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Virat Kohli, 1 run, pitched up by the bowler around middle and leg, flicked through square leg for one

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Devdutt Padikkal, B0$, B1$ Devdutt Padikkal looks in fine touch already. Quite evident in the couple of shots he has played so far. This was pitched up by the bowler around middle and leg, Devdutt Padikkal tickles it away to the fine leg fence for a nonchalant boundary

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Devdutt Padikkal, 1 run, on a length outside off, Devdutt Padikkal slices it through point for one

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Virat Kohli, leg byes, 1 run, fired on leg, Virat Kohli looks to flick this away, ends up getting an inside edge onto the pads. A single taken

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Devdutt Padikkal, B0$, another fine shot. On a length outside off, Devdutt Padikkal plants his front foot forward and thumps this over wide mid-off. He has played at this venue all his life and he's making it count at the start of the season

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Devdutt Padikkal, 1 run, back of a length outside off, shaping away from the batter, Devdutt Padikkal plays it late, steering it down to third man

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: David Payne to Devdutt Padikkal, no run, good length delivery around middle and leg, nudged towards mid-on by Devdutt Padikkal

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: David Payne to Devdutt Padikkal, B0$, full length delivery outside off, Devdutt Padikkal advances down the wicket and slices it over deep backward point, managing to clear the fielder stationed at the edge of the boundary

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: David Payne to Devdutt Padikkal, B0$, B1$ Back of a length delivery at the stumps, Devdutt Padikkal picks the length pretty early and whips this over mid-wicket. He's finding boundaries at his will for the moment. RCB are off to a superb start, chasing a massive total

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: David Payne to Devdutt Padikkal, 1 run, tries to cramp the batsman for room, back of a length around middle and leg as Devdutt Padikkal swipes it over backward square leg for one

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: David Payne to Virat Kohli, 1 run, slower back of a length delivery around off, Virat Kohli pats it with soft hands towards the off-side for a single

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: David Payne to Devdutt Padikkal, B0$, just look at the wrist work on that shot. Devdutt Padikkal, you beauty. He advances down the wicket, picks the slower one and flicks it over deep mid-wicket nonchalantly. He does look in sublime touch. Has raced away to 34 off 11 and B1$

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Jaydev Unadkat to Virat Kohli, no run, good length delivery around middle and leg, Virat Kohli swings across the line, doesn't middle it though

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Jaydev Unadkat to Virat Kohli, B0$, even Virat Kohli joins the party! The Chinnaswamy crowd erupt. On a length around middle and leg, Virat Kohli keeps his eyes on the ball and whips it over deep mid-wicket for a clean six. Runs coming thick and fast

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Jaydev Unadkat to Virat Kohli, B0$, B1$ Virat Kohli advances down the wicket and slashes this slightly short ball through covers for yet another boundary. They are making the most of the powerplay. Chants of "Kohli, Kohli" all across the Chinnaswamy

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Jaydev Unadkat to Virat Kohli, 1 run, pulls this short ball through mid-wicket for one

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Jaydev Unadkat to Devdutt Padikkal, byes, B0$, things going from bad to worse. A slower bouncer by Jaydev Unadkat and Devdutt Padikkal fails to get bat on it. Kishan can't gather the ball either as the ball spins away slightly after landing in front of him. Beats the keeper and races away to the fence eventually

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Jaydev Unadkat to Devdutt Padikkal, byes, 1 run, banged in short around middle and leg, Devdutt Padikkal looks to swipe across the line, it clips his thigh pad and rolls in front of the keeper. Kohli calls for a run, and they scamper across to complete it

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harsh Dubey to Devdutt Padikkal, B0$, tossed up delivery around middle and leg, Devdutt Padikkal goes down on his knee and sweeps this over backward square leg. Greets Harsh Dubey into the attack with a boundary

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harsh Dubey to Devdutt Padikkal, 1 run, yorks himself by advancing down the wicket. Squeezes it towards the off-side for one

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harsh Dubey to Virat Kohli, 1 run, full and straight on leg, Virat Kohli swings hard and gets an inside edge that deflects off the pads towards the on-side

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harsh Dubey to Devdutt Padikkal, 1 run, full and quick on middle and leg, Devdutt Padikkal heaves it towards long-on for one

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harsh Dubey to Virat Kohli, 1 run, down the wicket Virat Kohli advances and flicks this over wide mid-on, just managing to clear the fielder who was charging back

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harsh Dubey to Devdutt Padikkal, 1 run, makes room and drives it towards mid-off. A misfield by the fielder stationed there, results in a single

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Eshan Malinga to Devdutt Padikkal, B0$, short and wide outside off, Devdutt Padikkal slaps this over point to keep the runs flowing. No stopping him tonight, he has put SRH on the backfoot with his intent tonight

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Eshan Malinga to Devdutt Padikkal, 1 run, tad short outside off, sliced in front of point by Devdutt Padikkal

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Eshan Malinga to Virat Kohli, no run, a slower bouncer outside off, good change in pace as Virat Kohli looks to play an upper cut, getting beaten in the process

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Eshan Malinga to Virat Kohli, 2 runs, on a length around middle and leg, worked through the leg-side by Virat Kohli for a couple of runs, a fumble in the deep allowed him to take that second

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Eshan Malinga to Virat Kohli, B0$, is that the shot of the evening? For me, it definitely is. All about class. This was pitched up by the bowler, right into the slot, Virat Kohli waits for it to arrive and plays a perfect lofted straight drive. What skills, what class! Has been a fantastic start for RCB - these two batters are making batting look so delightful

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Eshan Malinga to Virat Kohli, no run, advances down the wicket and looks to drag this across the line, gets an inside edge towards the on-side

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harshal Patel to Devdutt Padikkal, 1 run, short ball by Harshal Patel, Devdutt Padikkal drags it through the leg-side for one

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harshal Patel to Virat Kohli, no run, appeal for a caught behind, but the umpire isn't interested! This was a yorker length ball outside off and Virat Kohli tried to squeeze it out. Gets beaten as Kishan takes it and they also go up in an appeal, only for the umpire to turn it down

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harshal Patel to Virat Kohli, 1 run, B0$ Klaasen, the culprit on this occasion. Virat Kohli whips it uppishly towards long-on and the fielder charges in from the deep. Guess he misjudged it slightly. Gets his fingers underneath, but the ball doesn't stick, it pops out. How costly will that dropped chance prove to be? Klaasen will hope, not much..

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harshal Patel to Devdutt Padikkal, B0$, B1$ He has been in top-notch form today. This was a length delivery around off and Devdutt Padikkal thumped it right over mid-off. Sublime timing as the ball almost goes the distance. Kohli walks upto him and congratulates him for bringing up the milestone. He would want to continue and convert this fifty into a formidable score though

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harshal Patel to Devdutt Padikkal, byes, B0$, Kishan was superb with the bat, but his keeping has been disappointing tonight. This was a short ball outside off which Devdutt Padikkal failed to connect. Kishan fumbles yet again and gifts away four byes

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harshal Patel to Devdutt Padikkal, no run, tad short outside off, punched into the off-side by DDP

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harsh Dubey to Virat Kohli, 1 run, B0$ This was fraction short outside off and Virat Kohli slapped it towards long-off for one

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harsh Dubey to Devdutt Padikkal, B0$, fortune favours the brave. Fraction short outside off, Devdutt Padikkal goes for a late-cut and the outside edge beats the fielder stationed at short third man. No chance of stopping that for the fielder

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harsh Dubey to Devdutt Padikkal, B0$, B1$ A tossed up delivery on middle and leg, Devdutt Padikkal goes down on his knee and sweeps it over deep backward square leg. Comfortably clears the boundary with this finely connected shot

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harsh Dubey to Devdutt Padikkal, B0$ Caught by Heinrich Klaasen!! End of a rollicking knock by Devdutt Padikkal. What an entertaining innings it was. 61 runs off just 26 balls, and he walks back to a standing ovation from the crowd and his teammates. This was tad full around off and Devdutt Padikkal went for the aerial route once again. Gets enough elevation, but not distance. Klaasen charges in from long-off and completes a rather easy catch in the outfield. Paddikal has brought the required run rate down to 8-odd with this knock. B1$,

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harsh Dubey to Rajat Patidar, 1 run, played towards long-on by Patidar as he opens his account

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harsh Dubey to Virat Kohli, no run, flatter through the air around off, knocked down the pitch by Virat Kohli

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harshal Patel to Rajat Patidar, 1 run, pushed to long-on by Rajat Patidar for a single

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harshal Patel to Virat Kohli, B0$, B1$ Gun shot, by a gun player. Not for the first time has he played such a shot. He has powerful wrists. This was back of a length delivery around middle and leg, Virat Kohli stays in the crease and whips it over deep square leg for a flat six. Makes it look so effortless

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harshal Patel to Virat Kohli, 1 run, dragged through mid-wicket by Virat Kohli for one

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harshal Patel to Rajat Patidar, B0$, captain into the act now. Short of a length outside off, Rajat Patidar rocks back in the crease and carves it through backward point as he stands there and admires his shot. Knew he didn't have to run for that, was so sure about the result

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harshal Patel to Rajat Patidar, 1 run, yorker length ball around middle and leg, Rajat Patidar squeezes it towards mid-on

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harshal Patel to Virat Kohli, B0$ banged in short by Harshal Patel outside off, this was probably a bit too wide

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Harshal Patel to Virat Kohli, 1 run, advances down the wicket and drives this through covers for a single by reaching out for it

Match_Name: ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD

Commentary_Text: Mohsin Khan to Sameer Rizvi, B0$, this is powerful shot. Mohsin for some reason has gone short in this over. He was so good bowling that back of a length in his first three overs. This was a change of pace as well, so sits up for Rizvi to have a crack, he middles the pull and sends it sailing over the deep square leg fence

Match_Name: LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Mohsin Khan to Sameer Rizvi, no run, angled in from back of a length, no room to work with and Rizvi defends back to Mohsin

Match_Name: LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Anrich Nortje to Tristan Stubbs, no run, 146.8ks short of length around off, Stubbs rides the bounce and knocks it to cover

Match_Name: LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Anrich Nortje to Tristan Stubbs, B0$, Stubbs joins in now. DC are on course to winning their opening game. Another short of length delivery, but this time there was a bit of width for Stubbs to free his hands, he nails the pull flat and over long-on. He intentionally hit it straighter as the mid-on fielder was inside the ring

Match_Name: LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Anrich Nortje to Tristan Stubbs, 1 run, full delivery on off, Stubbs eases it to mid-on and crosses over

Match_Name: LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Anrich Nortje to Sameer Rizvi, B0$, no chance for Rishabh Pant behind the stumps. Nortje sees Rizvi back away and tries to follow him with a bouncer, but it is too short and keeps bouncing. Pant jumps as high as possible but could not get there. The Capitals are one hit away now..

Match_Name: LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Anrich Nortje to Sameer Rizvi, no run, yorker around off, Rizvi moves away and is not able to squeeze it out. Rishabh Pant under arms the ball towards the stumps and it hits Rizvi on the boot. He walks away in pain. But quickly gets back to face the next ball..

Match_Name: LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Anrich Nortje to Sameer Rizvi, 1 run, fullish delivery around off, Rizvi makes room and creams the drive towards cover, Rathi with a diving stop

Match_Name: LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Anrich Nortje to Tristan Stubbs, no run, short of length delivery, Stubbs goes on his toes and punches it straight to cover

Match_Name: LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Abdul Samad to Sameer Rizvi, B0$, B1$ Rizvi finishes it off with a biggie. Samad was brought on to roll his arm over as the game was done. He gifts a rank long hop and Rizvi accepts it happily - rocks back and hammers the pull into the deep mid-wicket stand

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Vaibhav Arora to Travis Head, no run, bit of swing for Vaibhav. Pitches around middle and leg, nips away, Head has a look and lets it pass

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Vaibhav Arora to Travis Head, no run, uhhh! Swing and bounce this time. Shortens the length, lands it around leg and seams away, Head has a loose waft and is beaten on the outside-edge. Good carry through to Raghuvanshi

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Vaibhav Arora to Travis Head, no run, once again goes past the outside-edge. Back of a length, in the channel around off, Head stays rooted to the crease and has a tentative poke, lucky not to edge it. Vaibhav left with his hands on his head..

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Vaibhav Arora to Travis Head, 1 run, slanting away from the left-hander, Head throws his bat and slashes it towards deep backward point

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Vaibhav Arora to Abhishek Sharma, 1 run, back of a length close to off, Abhishek stands tall and knocks it to point, slight fumble by Anukul and it allows Abhishek to get off the mark

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Vaibhav Arora to Travis Head, B0$, Head ends the over with a boundary. Vaibhav became predictable with his length. Head was waiting for the shortish length, goes on one leg and whips it in front of square, beats mid-wicket and the ball races away

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Blessing Muzarabani to Abhishek Sharma, 1 run, fullish delivery on leg, Abhishek flicks in front of square and Rinku keeps it to a single

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Blessing Muzarabani to Travis Head, B0$, that's a gimme from Muzarabani. Short and angling across, ample width on offer and Head is not missing out, cracks it in front of square and the ball pierces the packed off-side ring. Not off the middle but enough for it to race away

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Blessing Muzarabani to Travis Head, B0$, hat-trick of fours for Head. Once again Muzarabani offers space for Head to free his hands, he goes up and over the off-side field, clears the inner ring and there's no stopping that

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Blessing Muzarabani to Travis Head, 1 run, slower ball at the stumps, Head waits and guides it to deep backward point

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Blessing Muzarabani to Abhishek Sharma, no run, short of length close to off, Abhishek gets behind the line and defends it back

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Blessing Muzarabani to Abhishek Sharma, B0$, there he goes. First six of the night. And it comes off Abhishek's willow. Short delivery and it comes on nicely, Abhishek hangs back and nails the pull in front of square. He took on the longer square boundary and cleared it with ease

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Vaibhav Arora to Travis Head, B0$, Rahane does not bother to chase. Angled across, but Head stays leg-side and gives himself the room to open his hands, thrashes it through extra cover and another mistimed shot that races across the turf

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Vaibhav Arora to Travis Head, no run, very full delivery on off, Head makes a bit of room and squeezes the drive to extra cover

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Vaibhav Arora to Travis Head, B0$, high and all the way! Sunrisers are on the charge. Vaibhav angles it in, lands it right in Head's arc and there's no missing out, lofted through the line and sends it sailing over the sightscreen

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Vaibhav Arora to Travis Head, B0$, back to back sixes. This is a poor delivery. Vaibhav tries to target the pads but offers a freebie down leg, Head backs away and whips it backward of square leg. 65 meter six..

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Vaibhav Arora to Travis Head, B0$, now through the off-side. Vaibhav is leaking on both the sides. The attempted yorker goes wrong - full toss outside off, Head reaches and opens the bat face to slice it over backward point. No one in the deep to stop that..

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Vaibhav Arora to Travis Head, B0$, tries to get away with a bouncer, but too short and too high, Head can't connect with the ramp and the square leg umpire signals a wide for height. How much will the extra ball cost?

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Vaibhav Arora to Travis Head, no run, that's better. Short and follows a backing away Head, cramps him for room and the upper cut can't be met, the ball flies over the top-edge. B0$

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Abhishek Sharma, no run, tossed up around off, Abhishek gently knocks it back to Narine

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Abhishek Sharma, no run, keeps it around leg, not much room on offer, Abhishek stays leg-side and knocks it to cover

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Abhishek Sharma, 1 run, flighted and drifting across leg, Abhishek nudges it through mid-wicket

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Travis Head, no run, same line for Head - down leg and no room, Head misses the flick and the ball deflects off the pad to short fine

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Travis Head, 2 runs, B0$ Tough chance and Rahane can't hang on. He gets fingertips. Head comes down the track, stays leg-side and looks to go down the ground, but the ball spins away and catches the outer half, skies over extra cover and Rahane backtracks, puts in the dive but can't cling on

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Travis Head, no run, flatter delivery at the stumps, Head stays back and eases it to extra cover

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Abhishek Sharma, B0$, he's greeted with a six. Flighted delivery on leg, Abhishek stays leg-side and has the space to extend his hands, clean swing of the bat and the ball sails over long-on

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Abhishek Sharma, no run, seam-up quick delivery, Abhishek opens the bat face and guides it to short third

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Abhishek Sharma, B0$, six more.. Chakaravarthy goes fast and short, 108.8ks and the ball skids on, Abhishek is waiting on the back foot - nails the pull flat and all the way over long-on. Pressure on Chakaravarthy..

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Abhishek Sharma, B0$, now a boundary. Overpitched outside off and Abhishek does not miss out, he bends the back knee and pumps it over extra cover, one bounce and over the ropes

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Abhishek Sharma, B0$, tries to keep it away from Abhishek's range and sprays it outside off, wide called

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Abhishek Sharma, B0$, nicely done! Abhishek shuffles across expecting Chakaravarthy to bowl outside off, the length is short and he does not overhit the cut, opens the bat face and splits the two fielders in the point region with precision

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Abhishek Sharma, B0$, B1$ Almost a repeat of the previous boundary. Short and outside off, Abhishek moves across and opens the bat face, slices the cut square and the fielders don't bother to chase it

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Kartik Tyagi to Travis Head, B0$, not off the middle but in the gap and four more.. Back of a length delivery, Head makes room and does not quite time the cut, but he hits it in front of square and wide of extra cover. And once the ball passes the infield at Eden then there's no point chasing it

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Kartik Tyagi to Travis Head, B0$, full and outside off, Head tries his best to reach but can't, wide signalled

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Kartik Tyagi to Travis Head, B0$, this is what happens when you come within his range. Kartik goes for an off-pace delivery, 117ks off-cutter but comes on nicely, Head had the width and he pumps it flat over deep extra cover. This is absolute carnage..

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Kartik Tyagi to Travis Head, no run, that's more like - B0$ back of a length delivery, right at Head and he defends it to the off-side

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Kartik Tyagi to Travis Head, B0$ Caught by Cameron Green!! Finally Eden Garden finds its voice. Loud cheer as Green hangs on. The partnership has been broken. Kartik is pumped. Much needed wicket for the home side. 142.2ks back of a length delivery, angled across the left-hander, Head tries to fetch the flat-batted shot and loses his grip, the bottom hand comes off the bat handle, he gets the shot off the cue-end and the ball goes straight up, Green backtracks from mid-on and hangs on safely. A nice little cameo from Head comes to an end. B1$

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Kartik Tyagi to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, low full toss on off, Kishan drives to extra cover and a half stop allows the pair to cross over comfortably

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Kartik Tyagi to Abhishek Sharma, 1 run, B0$ full and angled across, Abhishek opens the bat face and guides it towards deep backward point

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Abhishek Sharma, 1 run, 87.9ks slower and drifting across, Abhishek knocks it wide of cover and crosses over

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, 92.4ks flatter and at the stumps, Kishan moves across and clips it to deep mid-wicket

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Abhishek Sharma, B0$, bad delivery and put away. Very small margin for error. 90ks short of length and angling away, Abhishek had the width and he flays it over extra cover. There's a valiant dive in the deep by Anukul but he's nowhere close to stopping that

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Abhishek Sharma, no run, slower and the ball stops a bit, Abhishek is early into the push and checks his shot, angles it to backward point

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Abhishek Sharma, B0$, once again Narine misses his line and is made to pay. 94.6ks short and around leg, Abhishek swivels around in the crease and pulls it high towards deep square leg. He gets the distance as well..

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Abhishek Sharma, 2 runs, short and drifting away, Abhishek opens the bat face and slices it backward of point, couple more

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Kartik Tyagi to Ishan Kishan, no run, 143.3ks good length ball angled across, Kishan throws his bat and is beaten on the outside-edge. Not much bounce on this delivery as it barely carries to Raghuvanshi

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Kartik Tyagi to Ishan Kishan, B0$, the off-pace delivery is not working for Kartik. He went for runs against Head as well. 117.3ks slower ball bowled into the surface, sits up nicely and Kishan nails the pull in front of square, splits the two fielders in the deep perfectly

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Kartik Tyagi to Ishan Kishan, B0$, nicely done! B1$ very full and outside off, close to yorker length, Kishan bends down and reaches it, squeezes it to the right of backward point and beats the diving fielder

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Kartik Tyagi to Ishan Kishan, B0$, hat-trick of fours. This was touch and go. Full pitcher around off, Kishan wanted to go over mid-off as the fielder was inside the ring, does not quite middle it but gets enough to evade the leaping fielder

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Kartik Tyagi to Ishan Kishan, no run, 118ks slower short of length delivery, Kishan looks to pull and chops it onto the pads, luckily the ball drops dead near his feet instead of rolling back onto the stumps

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Kartik Tyagi to Ishan Kishan, no run, 145.1ks back of a length angled across, Kishan tries to run it down to third man and is beaten o the outside-edge

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Blessing Muzarabani to Abhishek Sharma, 1 run, starts with a slower ball - 110.1ks leg-lined delivery, Abhishek clips it over the mid-wicket region

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Blessing Muzarabani to Ishan Kishan, B0$ Caught by Rinku Singh!! Gone! Well-judged catch by Rinku. Muzarabani comes back and gets the big wicket of Kishan. This was not quite a wicket-taking delivery - short and angled across, plenty of width on offer and Kishan goes hard on the cut, slashes it in front of square and picks out Rinku at sweeper cover. He steadies himself just inside the rope and takes it over his head. Wickets are the only way KKR are going to stop this SRH batting line-up. B1$

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Blessing Muzarabani to Heinrich Klaasen, 1 run, 134ks angling in around the hips, Klaasen gloves the pull backward of square leg

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Blessing Muzarabani to Abhishek Sharma, B0$ Caught by Varun Chakaravarthy!! Loud cheer goes around Eden Garden. Second wicket in the over. Muzarabani is doing the job for KKR. Kishan and Abhishek both back in the hut. The home side are right back in the game and the jubilation is quite evident. 112ks slower short of length delivery, right at the batter and Abhishek did not have much space to play the pull, but he still manages to hit it flat towards deep square leg. The ball was dying on Varun but he does extremely well. For someone who is not known for his fielding, this is a terrific catch - he quickly moves to his right, bends down low and scoops it centimeters above the ground. No fifty for Abhishek as well. B1$

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Blessing Muzarabani to Aniket Verma, leg byes, B0$, that's a poor delivery. Strays down leg, Verma misses the glance and the ball deflects off the thigh pad, beats Angkrish Raghuvanshi and runs away to the fence

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Blessing Muzarabani to Aniket Verma, B0$, another slower ball that Muzarabani slips down leg, Verma can't meet with the glance and the ball does not brush anything on the way to the keeper. The umpire thought there was a touch and hence didn't signal a wide, but he had to change his decision

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Blessing Muzarabani to Aniket Verma, 1 run, 104.5ks off-pace delivery, Verma nudges it to square leg and gets off the mark

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Anukul Roy to Aniket Verma, no run, flatter and sliding in, Verma clears his front leg and misses the flick, struck on the back pad but it was missing leg-stump

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Anukul Roy to Aniket Verma, B0$ Caught by Rinku Singh!! Three wickets in quick time. Kolkata Knight Riders are right back in the contest. Anukul was held back because of the left-handers at the crease. But with two right-handers out, he was brought in and he strikes with his second ball. He throws it up outside off and makes Verma reach for the big shot, not quite off the middle and Rinku runs to his left near long-off to complete the catch. He made that catch look easy. B1$

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Anukul Roy to Nitish Reddy, 1 run, 92.9ks attacks the stumps, Reddy tucks it to square leg

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Anukul Roy to Heinrich Klaasen, 1 run, 93.8ks flatter delivery around off, Klaasen eases it to long-off

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Anukul Roy to Nitish Reddy, 1 run, 85.7ks short and outside off, Reddy cracks it square on the off-side

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Anukul Roy to Heinrich Klaasen, 2 runs, 88.1ks flighted but short in length, Klaasen cuts it in front of square and Vaibhav fumbles in the deep, concedes the extra run

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Nitish Reddy, 1 run, 96ks drifting into middle and leg, Reddy clips it backward of square

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Heinrich Klaasen, 1 run, 94.6ks googly around off, Klaasen eases it to long-on

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Nitish Reddy, 1 run, 96.4ks wrong 'un close to off, Reddy tucks it through mid-wicket

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Heinrich Klaasen, 1 run, quicker and at the stumps, Klaasen is rushed into bringing his bat down, stabs it to the right of Chakaravarthy

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Nitish Reddy, 1 run, fullish delivery around off, Reddy drives it down to long-off

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Heinrich Klaasen, 1 run, short and bowled into the wicket, Klaasen knocks it to long-on

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Anukul Roy to Heinrich Klaasen, 2 runs, makes room and Anukul follows him, clipped wide of long-on and the pair scamper back for the second

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Anukul Roy to Heinrich Klaasen, B0$, 90.9ks fired outside off, not within the guideline and Klaasen lets it pass

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Anukul Roy to Heinrich Klaasen, no run, very similar to the previous delivery and Klaasen leaves, but this is within the marker. No wide call

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Anukul Roy to Heinrich Klaasen, no run, fired into the blockhole, Klaasen brings his bat down and jams it back to Anukul

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Anukul Roy to Heinrich Klaasen, 2 runs, short and outside off, Klaasen slaps it in front of square and Reddy races back for the second

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Anukul Roy to Heinrich Klaasen, B0$, tries that wide line outside off, but can't keep it within the tramline, another wide

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Anukul Roy to Heinrich Klaasen, 1 run, 93.4ks darted into yorker length, Klaasen digs it out to long-on

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Anukul Roy to Nitish Reddy, B0$, boundary after a while. Runs were coming in ones and twos, but Anukul throws one up outside off for Reddy and he accepts the invitation, creams the drive in front of square and gives the sweeper no chance

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Heinrich Klaasen, B0$, just over Rahane. 85ks off-break that follows a backing away Klaasen, he still goes through the big shot, flays it over cover and beats Rahane leaps inside the ring

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Heinrich Klaasen, 1 run, short and turning in, Klaasen pulls to deep backward square

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Nitish Reddy, 1 run, 95.1ks fullish delivery around off, Reddy eases it to long-on

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Heinrich Klaasen, 2 runs, off-break that ends up on the pads, Klaasen clips it to deep square leg and scampers back for the second

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Heinrich Klaasen, 1 run, 90.4ks short and around off, Klaasen makes room and cracks it to sweeper cover

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Nitish Reddy, no run, 85.3ks flighted and turns in, Reddy prods forward and ekes out an inside-edge onto the pad

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD

Commentary_Text: Eshan Malinga to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, B0$ Cameron Green Run Out!! They say you never run of a misfield or fumble and this is exactly why. Raghuvanshi hits it straight back to Malinga, who sticks his boot out and half stops. Green first ensures he's back in the crease, but then sees Raghuvanshi take a start and decides to go for the single. Raghuvanshi can't spot where the ball has gone and he pauses, by which time Green was already halfway down the pitch, so he had no option but go for the run. The ball rolls towards the stump at the bowler's end. Malinga runs back, picks up the ball and lights up the stumps. Raghuvanshi was the one who started walking back to the pavilion as it looked like he had crossed Green but he's made to wait by the fourth umpire near the boundary rope. The third umpire has a look and sees that both batters are in the same line on the opposite side of the pitch, so Green is the one given out. Raghuvanshi was extremely unhappy as he walking back to the dugout, but he gets to go back while a disappointed Green makes his way back to the pavilion. B1$

Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to Yashasvi Jaiswal, no run, 134.1ks angled across the left-hander, Jaiswal attempts the slash and the ball sneaks under his bat, does not carry through to Buttler as well

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to Yashasvi Jaiswal, B0$, B1$ It has been a composed innings. He has not gone hammer and tongs as he usually does. Has bided his time and now it is go-time. Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to Dhruv Jurel, B0$, streaky but Jurel and RR won't be complaining. Siraj goes short and into the wicket, pace off delivery and Jurel is a bit early into the pull, gets a top-edge and the ball flies away wide of Buttler

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to Dhruv Jurel, B0$, those last two balls turn it into an expensive over. He used the bottom hand and whipped it all the way into the crowd

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Yashasvi Jaiswal, no run, in the air and safe. 141.6ks back of a length delivery, Jaiswal is backing away and closes the bat face to tuck it into the leg-side, gets a leading edge and the ball lands in front of the incoming mid-off fielder

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Yashasvi Jaiswal, B0$, nicely done! He missed out in the previous over but not this time. This is a slower ball bowled into the wicket, Jaiswal shuffles a long way across and laps it fine - to the right of Buttler and he can only watch it fly past him

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Yashasvi Jaiswal, B0$ Bowled!! Cleaned up! A fine knock comes to an end. Rabada was brought on exactly for this - get rid of the set batter. B1$

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Prasidh Krishna to Riyan Parag, B0$ Caught by Kumar Kushagra!! Soft dismissal! Prasidh comes back and strikes, just like Rabada. Rajasthan Royals have lost wickets in consecutive overs. 142.3ks good length ball outside off, Parag is half-hearted with his push and the extra bounce that Prasidh generates, hits the higher part of the bat and flies to backward point. Kushagra went reverse cup and almost messed up, luckily the ball got caught in his right hand even as the left hand came off. B1$

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Prasidh Krishna to Shimron Hetmyer, no run, fullish delivery angled in, Hetmyer eases it to mid-off

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Prasidh Krishna to Shimron Hetmyer, no run, low full toss around off, Hetmyer pushes it straight to cover

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Prasidh Krishna to Shimron Hetmyer, B0$, back to back sixes. That missed opportunity is already costing them. He suggests that he lost it for a while behind the lights, but still managed to hang on. An excellent knock comes to an end. B1$

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Glenn Phillips, 1 run, wrong 'un that is short, Phillips hangs back and punches to long-on

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Jos Buttler, B0$, Buttler ends the over with a boundary. Bishnoi is not changing his length. This was a leg-break which was short and wide, Buttler didn't overhit the cut - waited for the ball to come and just directed it square on the off-side. No chance for the sweeper to get around and stop

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Glenn Phillips, 1 run, 139ks back of a length around off, Phillips knocks it wide of cover and gets off strike

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Jos Buttler, B0$, this is Buttler at his best. He shuffles across his stumps, waits for the 139.2ks good length ball to angle in and laps it fine to the left of Jurel. The ball almost travels the distance..

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Jos Buttler, 1 run, 136ks short and outside off, Buttler cuts behind square and the sweeper does well to keep it to a single

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Glenn Phillips, 1 run, short and bowled into the wicket, Phillips goes on his toes and cracks it square of the wicket

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Jos Buttler, B0$, stand and deliver. Length delivery with ample width on offer, Buttler maintains a solid base and extends his arms to tonk it over extra cover. Mid-off was inside the ring and Buttler just hit this through the line

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Jos Buttler, B0$, Buttler is on the charge. He's showing his range. Short and banged into the wicket, sits up nicely outside off, Buttler transfers his weight back and nails the pull in front of square. No need to run for that..

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Glenn Phillips, B0$ Caught by Jofra Archer!! Second wicket for Bishnoi. "B1$ - youngest Indian to reach the mark," informs Deep Dasgupta on air. This was the googly and not quite short for Phillips to play the pull, he does not get under the shot and miscues it to long-on. Archer comes in and bends low to take it inches from the ground. That's a good catch. Rajasthan Royals keep striking at regular intervals. B2$

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Washington Sundar, B0$, Sundar is off the mark with a boundary. Bishnoi overcooks the flighted delivery, feeds it right in the slot and Sundar does not miss out, lofts it straight back over Bishnoi and picks up the four

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Washington Sundar, B0$ Caught by Ravindra Jadeja!! Third wicket for Bishnoi. Four and out for Sundar. The move to hold Bishnoi back is paying off - he is causing a massive dent in Gujarat Titans' line-up. Googly around leg, Sundar thinks this is in the slot as well, bends low and whips it to deep mid-wicket, straight to Jadeja and he ain't dropping that. B1$

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Rahul Tewatia, no run, quick googly around off, Tewatia angles it to backward point

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Rahul Tewatia, 1 run, short and outside off, Tewatia cuts it square of the wicket

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Jos Buttler, B0$ Caught by Sandeep Sharma!! Wickets tumbling now. Gujarat Titans have gone from 127/2 to 133/5. B1$ The dangerous Buttler is gone and Rajasthan Royals have gained the upper hand in this contest. Burger comes from round the wicket, bangs it halfway down the wicket, rushes Buttler on the pull shot and the top-edge flies to fine leg, Sandeep bends down and takes it low to the ground. Buttler was looking in ominous form but he departs, leaving the Titans in a spot of bother. B2$

Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Shahrukh Khan, 1 run, back of a length angled in, Shahrukh tucks it square on the leg-side and opens his account

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Rahul Tewatia, B0$ Caught by Dhruv Jurel!! Bishnoi has the last laugh. Fourth wicket for him. What a spell! He's turned this game around. Wrong 'un which is short and outside off, Tewatia goes for the cut and gets an outside-edge. Sharp catch behind the wicket by Jurel. Tewatia knew and started walking immediately. The boundaries are flowing but the wickets are also tumbling for the Gujarat Titans. B1$

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Rashid Khan, B0$, that's beaten everything - inside-edge, stumps and Jurel. Googly that spins in sharply, Rashid is rooted to the crease and has a tentative prod. Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Rashid Khan, B0$ Shahrukh Khan Run Out!! 2 runs completed. There you go.. Another one walks back to the dugout. Needless! Floated up outside off, overpitched and Rashid drives it in front of square. Long chase for the sweeper and Jadeja gets there, stops the ball and goes over the rope before coming back and sending in a bullet throw to the striker's end. Jurel does the rest and Shahrukh is well short of the crease. It seemed to be Rashid's call for the third and Shahrukh responded, it was risky and they are made to pay. B1$

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS

His figures read - B1$

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Kagiso Rabada, B0$, low full toss outside off, Rabada tries his best to reach it but can't, wide signalled. B1$..

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS

Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Rashid Khan, B0$ Caught by Jofra Archer!! Excellent catch under pressure from Archer. Deshpande is pumped. Look at him celebrate. Archer runs to his right, slides and hangs on with both hands. B1$

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Ashok Sharma, no run, B0$ Tushar Deshpande, take a bow! He runs off and does the this-is-my-territory kinda celebration. Credit to Parag as well for trusting him over a seasoned campaigner like Sandeep Sharma and an international bowler like Nandre Burger. No one bothers what happened after that as RR's players were busy running towards Deshpande
