Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Riyan Parag, 1 run, watchfully flicks this short of length delivery through mid-on

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Yashasvi Jaiswal, no run, oh tried to be cheeky with a late cut, almost beat short third man for four but Shardul managed to dive to right and cut it off

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Yashasvi Jaiswal, 1 run, short slower delivery, Jaiswal pulls to deep mid-wicket

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Riyan Parag, B0$, this is so cunning from Riyan. Played that so, so late with angled bat. Oh wow, he's actually defended that ball late and wasn't the usual guide. The kind of defence that Kane Williamson plays so late to pinch a single to third man. Bumrah smiles and walks back as he knows it was a smart shot

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Riyan Parag, 1 run, short slower delivery, Parag pulls to mid-wicket

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Yashasvi Jaiswal, 1 run, yorker, Jaiswal digs it out towards mid-off

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Hardik Pandya to Yashasvi Jaiswal, 1 run, full toss, Jaiswal gently drives to long-off

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Hardik Pandya to Riyan Parag, 1 run, Parag wanted to whip it over long leg but missed out. Inside edge onto pad and rolling to short fine leg

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Hardik Pandya to Yashasvi Jaiswal, B0$, short and wide outside off stump, cuts it hard and it rockets to the deep point boundary. B1$ for Jaiswal. Raises the bat to the crowd and the dugout. Launched into Deepak Chahar in the first over and set the tone for RR

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Hardik Pandya to Yashasvi Jaiswal, 1 run, good ball! Followed Jaiswal as he backed away, whipped to long-on on the bounce

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Hardik Pandya to Riyan Parag, no run, oh tried to be too cute by leaving a wide yorker but it wasn't a wide. Precious dot for MI

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Hardik Pandya to Riyan Parag, B0$, in the air, Shardulll, Shardullll and it's just over his acrobatic leap! Full toss as Hardik Pandya misses the yorker, Parag whipped that with style so it went high than long. Shardul moved to the right at deep mid-wicket. He was in play for a good part but he couldn't get his hands on it despite a dive. In fact replays show he got hands to it but couldn't hold on or parry the ball back into the playing area

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: AM Ghazanfar to Yashasvi Jaiswal, B0$, full ball, Jaiswal leaves nothing in the tank and goes real hard down the ground. Ball goes off the bottom of the bat and lands just inside the rope

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: AM Ghazanfar to Yashasvi Jaiswal, 1 run, on the pads, Jaiswal swings too hard, gets an inside edge that rolls to short fine leg

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: AM Ghazanfar to Riyan Parag, no run, oh under edge onto Ryan Rickelton's pads. No way the keeper can catch those. Flatter delivery, Parag looks to slash and gets away with the under edge

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: AM Ghazanfar to Riyan Parag, B0$, this is high and long enough over long-on. Slot ball, Parag gets under it and gets decent power behind the shot to get another maximum

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: AM Ghazanfar to Riyan Parag, B0$ Caught by Tilak Varma!! This is flat, long-on in business and taken. Parag thought he could have another six down the ground. Cleared the front leg out of the way and attempted the six, but the ball went off the bottom of the bat and stayed well inside the rope. B1$

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: AM Ghazanfar to Shimron Hetmyer, 1 run, flatter delivery, Hetmyer cuts to point and keeps strike

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Shimron Hetmyer, no run, starts with a dot! Slower delivery angling across, Hetmyer lets it go as he couldn't line it up

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Shimron Hetmyer, 1 run, yorker on the stumps, Hetmyer digs it out square of the wicket for a run

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Yashasvi Jaiswal, B0$, tries to beat him with a slower bumper but the square leg ump didn't like the height on that

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Yashasvi Jaiswal, B0$, that is muscled! Even Bumrah can miss yorkers folks. It's such a tough ball and the moment he saw the ball make contact with the bat he threw his back in disappointment that he offered a slot ball. Jaiswal sends it soaring over the sightscreen and someone in the stands dropped the catch

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Yashasvi Jaiswal, 1 run, mistimed to long-off

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Shimron Hetmyer, no run, short slower delivery outside off stump, Hetmyer looks to pull and misses

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Shimron Hetmyer, 1 run, Hetmyer had no clue that it would arrive today and he finished his slog yesterday. Great slower ball, toe-ended to the right of the bowler for a single

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Shardul Thakur to Shimron Hetmyer, 2 runs, starts off with a full wide ball, Hetmyer mistimes the slog to the on-side and they get two as the man from the deep had to run forward to mid-wicket

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Shardul Thakur to Shimron Hetmyer, B0$, tries the wide yorker and it's outside off stump. B1$ That's well outside the line and Kumar Dharmasena has to reverse the call. Looked wide to the naked eye

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Shardul Thakur to Shimron Hetmyer, 1 run, great yorker, Hetmyer mistimes it to mid-wicket off the inside edge

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Shardul Thakur to Yashasvi Jaiswal, B0$, that's a full toss wide of off stump. And tell you what, full credit to Yashasvi Jaiswal for trying to open the face and guide the ball in the final ball of the innings when it was easy for him to swing too hard given the situation of the game. Third man up so he just guides it to the left of that fielder and gets four

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Shardul Thakur to Yashasvi Jaiswal, B0$, that's too high. Slower ball bumper goes over the head. B1$ just a waste of time as Jaiswal is leaping and it is still well over his head. They check for the catch as well but the ball is away from the bat

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Shardul Thakur to Yashasvi Jaiswal, no run, brilliant off-side yorker, Jaiswal tries to squeeze it out but misses. Appeal for catch but the ump says no. No bat on it

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Shardul Thakur to Yashasvi Jaiswal, B0$, smart! Finally Jaiswal connects with the scoop. He knew Shardul Thakur was only going to try the wide yorker, so he moves off-side to unsettle the bowler and the bowler bangs it into the wicket to make it easy with the scoop. Fine to the right of Ryan Rickelton for four more

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Shardul Thakur to Yashasvi Jaiswal, B0$, back to the wide yorker and too wide

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Shardul Thakur to Yashasvi Jaiswal, B0$, full and outside off stump, in the slot and Jaiswal gets under it to smack it over cover. He does the fist pump as he absolutely enjoyed thrashing the ball tonight.

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Ryan Rickelton, 1 run, 139.5ks short of length delivery, Rickelton rides the bounce and pats it towards backward point

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Rohit Sharma, 1 run, fuller in length, it was there for Rohit to loft through the line, he does exactly that but ekes out an inside-edge onto the pad, the ball rolls to cover and the pair cross over

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Ryan Rickelton, 1 run, back of a length delivery, no width on offer and Rickelton can only knock it towards cover

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Rohit Sharma, 1 run, 138.7ks full and swinging in, Rohit picks it off the pads but there's protection at deep mid-wicket, just a single. Archer wanted Jadeja to come for the catch but the ball landed well in front

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Ryan Rickelton, B0$, there goes Rickelton. First for Mumbai Indians. 138.8ks length delivery, around middle and leg, Rickelton picks it nonchalantly and desposts it into the deep mid-wicket stand

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Ryan Rickelton, B0$ Caught by Dhruv Jurel!! Archer strikes back! Excellent catch from Dhruv Jurel. That ball went high and took some time to come down, but Jurel takes his cap off to get a better sight of the ball, runs back a few yards and hangs on with both hands. 140.2ks back of a length, angled across the left-hander and Rickelton attempted his favourite heave to the leg-side, gets more of the top-edge and then Jurel comes into the picture. B1$

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Rohit Sharma, 3 runs, 124.1ks back of a length delivery, Rohit rides the bounce and punches it in front of square, beats a diving cover-point but the ball does not have enough to race away. Jaiswal chases it down and hauls it in with a full stretch dive, saves a run

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Suryakumar Yadav, B0$, well, well! First ball and Suryakumar plays the lap. No sighters in such a short game. 143.2ks leg-lined, Suryakumar sits down inside the line and uses the pace on offer to lap it all the way over fine leg

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Suryakumar Yadav, B0$, sprays it down leg, Suryakumar misses the glance and Kumar Dharmasena signals a wide

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Suryakumar Yadav, no run, 143.8ks good length ball around off, Suryakumar camps back and angles it to backward point

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Suryakumar Yadav, B0$ Caught by Jofra Archer!! Gone! This is a massive wicket. Suryakumar departs cheaply. Burger roars looking at SKY. 125.5ks pace off short of length delivery, Suryakumar swivels to play the pull but since there's no pace, he does not get the power to clear deep backward square. Archer bends down, sits on his knees and reverse cups it safely. This is turning into an excellent start for the Royals. B1$

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Tilak Varma, 2 runs, 144.1ks fullish delivery and Tilak is drawn into the drive, squirts an inside-edge backward of square leg and opens his account with a brace

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Tilak Varma, no run, charges down and is met by a 126.7ks slower ball, no width as well and Tilak stabs it to the right of Burger

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sandeep Sharma to Rohit Sharma, no run, fullish delivery around off, Rohit pushes it off the outer half to backward point

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sandeep Sharma to Rohit Sharma, no run, speared into the blockhole, Rohit brings his bat down and jams it to short third. Tilak not keen on the single

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sandeep Sharma to Rohit Sharma, B0$ Lbw!! That's crashing into the base of middle-stump. Not sure why Rohit reviewed that. Mumbai Indians are three down and lose a review as well. This is brilliant from Sandeep. He has brought Jurel up to the stumps, then attacks the sticks. He's bowled a perfect yorker and Rohit premeditated the lap, gets into a tangle and falls over while playing the shot, misses it completely and is struck on the back leg. He had shuffled across and was hit in-line with the stumps. Simple decision for Mohit Krishnadas but Rohit still decided to send it upstairs. B1$

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sandeep Sharma to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, good length ball close to off, Hardik drives on the up towards mid-off and Parag makes a fine stop, saves a few

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sandeep Sharma to Tilak Varma, no run, angled in from round the wicket, no room on offer and Tilak eases it to the right of Sandeep

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sandeep Sharma to Tilak Varma, B0$, 121ks darted down leg, Tilak tries to help it along and does not connect. Wide called. Excellent take by Jurel

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sandeep Sharma to Tilak Varma, 1 run, 108.5ks slower back of a length delivery, Tilak punches to long-on. Just 3 runs and the wicket of Rohit

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Tilak Varma, B0$, Mumbai Indians need a move on. Deshpande starts with a slower ball - 112.9ks outside off, Tilak fetches it from there and whips it over mid-on, one bounce and over the ropes

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Tilak Varma, 1 run, 121.1ks short and banged into the surface, Tilak miscues the pull and gets enough for the ball to clear the infield. Poor running as a second was definitely on but Hardik wasn't interested

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Hardik Pandya, B0$, in the air and in the gap. Full pitcher around off, there for the drive and Hardik did not bother to keep it down, creams it through extra cover and watches the ball race away

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Hardik Pandya, no run, 122.1ks slower short of length delivery, Hardik gives everything on the slash and still does not connect. The ball bounces on the way to Jurel. Hardik looks at the square leg umpire for height and is not happy it wasn't given one short ball for the over

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Hardik Pandya, byes, 1 run, slower bouncer, Hardik lets it go and Jurel fumbles as the ball bounces in front of him. Still no wide as Hardik had bent his knees

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Tilak Varma, 1 run, off-pace delivery, Tilak chops it to sweeper cover and retains strike

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Tilak Varma, 1 run, very full delivery on leg, Tilak digs it out to mid-wicket and Bishnoi chases it himself

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Hardik Pandya, B0$, shot! That's more like it from Hardik. Short and outside off, he stays leg-side of the ball and gives himself the space to have a clean flow of the hands, crashes it in front of square and gives sweeper no chance

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Hardik Pandya, B0$ Caught by Yashasvi Jaiswal!! Bishnoi strikes in his first over once again! Did that against GT as well when he removed a well-set Sudarshan, today gets the dangerous Hardik. 101.4ks quicker delivery, but the length is held back, Hardik thinks it is in the slot and lofts through the line. He gets it high on the bat and Jaiswal runs to his left from long-on to take a good catch. He was on the move when he completed the catch. B1$

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Naman Dhir, 1 run, 97.4ks googly around off, Dhir leans forward and works it through mid-wicket

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Tilak Varma, B0$, excellent placement! 93ks wrong 'un that's dragged short, Tilak hangs back and powers the pull in front of square, splitting deep mid-wicket and long-on perfectly

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Tilak Varma, B0$ Caught by Shimron Hetmyer!! Second wicket in the over and Mumbai Indians are tottering. Half the side is back in the hut. Bishnoi is pumped. Another googly, which is full and at the stumps, Tilak sits down to play the slog sweep and does not quite get under the length, miscues it to deep mid-wicket and Hetmyer takes a simple catch. B1$

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sandeep Sharma to Naman Dhir, no run, uhhh! That didn't bounce. Sandeep's slingy action does not allow the ball to bounce, Dhir is camping back and the ball sneaks under his bat. Luckily for him it was not on target

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sandeep Sharma to Naman Dhir, 2 runs, 121.5ks good length ball at the stumps, Dhir drives wide of long-on and Jaiswal charges in, fumbles and concedes the extra run

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sandeep Sharma to Naman Dhir, B0$, smashed! Slower ball banged into the pitch, sits up nicely outside off and Dhir nails the pull, he gets it off the meat and the ball sails over the cow corner fence

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sandeep Sharma to Naman Dhir, no run, B0$ Rutherford had given up. Dhir toe-ends the drive and the ball rolls straight to backward point. Jadeja has plenty of time and he takes aim at the non-striker's end, misses the target and Rutherford survives. He had given up and fortunately Jadeja did not hit the stumps

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sandeep Sharma to Naman Dhir, B0$, edged and four. Fullish delivery, not much pace on offer and Dhir throws the kitchen sink on the big shot, the thick outside-edge flies away between Jurel and short third

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sandeep Sharma to Naman Dhir, 2 runs, full pitcher on off, Dhir presents the full face of the bat and drives it into the ground, the ball bounces past Sandeep and the fielder gets around from long-off to tidy up

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Sherfane Rutherford, 2 runs, B0$ Jaiswal does the hard work of getting there. But does not hang on. It was the googly, spins away a bit and Rutherford looks to go down the ground, miscues it off the toe-end and the ball skies up in front of long-off. Jaiswal charges in and gets there, goes with both hands and shells it

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Sherfane Rutherford, 2 runs, wrong 'un around leg, Rutherford nudges it into the mid-wicket pocket and races back for the second

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Sherfane Rutherford, B0$, short and spinning away outside off, Rutherford lets it pass and collects the wide

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Sherfane Rutherford, 1 run, in the air and wide of Bishnoi. 94.3ks flatter delivery, Rutherford works it uppishly to the left of Bishnoi

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Naman Dhir, 1 run, short and outside off, Dhir cracks it in front of square and picks out sweeper cover

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Sherfane Rutherford, B0$, nicely done! 94.3ks googly around off, Rutherford waits for the ball to come, opens the bat face and slices it towards backward point. Sooryavanshi dives over the ball and allows it to escape past him

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Ravi Bishnoi to Sherfane Rutherford, B0$, just over Parag. Did he get a fingertip? Bishnoi wasn't happy with the effort. Flighted and drifted across, the length was full enough to play the drive and Rutherford hits it aerially towards extra cover. Evades a leaping Parag on the edge of the circle and collects the boundary

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Naman Dhir, B0$, that's poor execution. Third man is inside the ring and Deshpande offers a short of length delivery outside off, it was pace off but Dhir just had to clear 30 yards, which he does with ease and the ball races away

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Naman Dhir, 1 run, 135.2ks very full delivery around off, Dhir drives it down to long-on

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Sherfane Rutherford, B0$, smoked! Deshpande misses the yorker and Rutherford launches him into the stands. Full delivery, right in the slot outside off, Rutherford maintains a solid base and lofts it over deep extra cover. 92-meter six..

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Sherfane Rutherford, B0$, slower bouncer but too short and well over Rutherford, called wide for height

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Sherfane Rutherford, B0$, is there still life left in this contest? Deshpande is dishing out freebies here - full toss just below the waist, Rutherford swivels around and helps it over long leg. The line was right at the body and Rutherford did extremely well to get it over the rope

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Sherfane Rutherford, B0$ Caught by Sandeep Sharma!! Deshpande and the Royals are celebrating. Rutherford stands his ground. But reluctantly starts his walk back to the dugout. Excellent catch by Sandeep. Slower ball angled across, there was width on offer and Rutherford went hard on the slash, slices it to short third and the ball was dying on Sandeep, he bends down and scoops it inches above the ground. Third umpire has a look and flashes OUT on the giantscreen. B1$

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Tushar Deshpande to Shardul Thakur, 1 run, dipping low full toss, Thakur bends down and skews it off the toe-end, the ball lands in front of backward point and short third. Burger puts in the dive and makes the stop

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Shardul Thakur, B0$, neatly done! Burger comes from round the wicket and angles it in, the length is a bit short but Thakur moves across his stumps, gets under the length and laps it past short fine

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Shardul Thakur, 1 run, fullish delivery around off, Thakur drives sans timing to long-on

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Naman Dhir, no run, on a length and outside off, Dhir drives and picks out extra cover

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Naman Dhir, B0$, smart batting. Dhir is not trying to overhit his shots. He allows this ball to arrive outside off, opens the bat face and slices it over short third. He clears the inner ring comfortably and there's no stopping that

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Naman Dhir, B0$ Caught by Ravi Bishnoi!! That should be the game. Dhir was the last recognised batter and he too departs with 13 balls left. Burger goes pace on and Dhir could not middle his big shot. 143.6ks full delivery at the stumps, Dhir clears his front leg and lofts through the line, straight down Bishnoi's throat at long-on. B1$

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Deepak Chahar, leg byes, B0$, boundary to end the over. Strays down leg, Chahar gets inside the line and misses the glance, the ball takes a big deflection off the thigh pad and races wide of Jurel

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS MUMBAI INDIANS

Commentary_Text: Rashid Khan to Axar Patel, 1 run, 92.5ks short of length leg-break, Axar knocks it wide of cover and crosses over

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Rashid Khan to Rahul, no run, 95.2ks quicker and at the stumps, Rahul defends to the right of Rashid

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Rashid Khan to Rahul, 1 run, 93.4ks drifting into leg, Rahul clips it to deep mid-wicket

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Rashid Khan to Axar Patel, B0$ Caught by Glenn Phillips!! Rashid caps off his spell with a wicket. Excellent catch from Phillips. The change in angle works superbly. He throws up the googly and invites Axar into the big shot, the ball grips a little and spins away, Axar looks to go down the ground but the away turns means he slices the shot over extra cover. If the Titans had to pick one fielder to catch then it would have been Phillips. He turns around, sprints back and dives full length to take it with both hands. B1$

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Rahul, B0$, starts with an in-angler down leg, Rahul misses the glance and it is signalled a wide

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Rahul, B0$, Rahul continues to motor along from one end. This is a slot delivery and he puts it away nonchalantly. Rabada misses the yorker and Rahul pumps his down the ground. No need to run for that..

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Rahul, 1 run, 127ks slower short ball, Rahul gets on top of the bounce and pulls towards deep mid-wicket

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Tristan Stubbs, 1 run, good length ball around off, Stubbs eases it to long-on

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Rahul, 1 run, 125.7ks another off-pace delivery banged in, gets big on Rahul and he miscues the pull, lands short and wide of Phillips at deep mid-wicket, just a single

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Tristan Stubbs, no run, 142.2ks back of a length close to off, not quite there for the pull but Stubbs goes for it, the ball sneaks past his inside-edge

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Tristan Stubbs, no run, couple of dots to end the over. 140.8ks short of length delivery angled in, Stubbs misses the tuck and is struck on the thigh pad, the ball drops down on the pitch

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Ashok Sharma to Rahul, B0$, boundary first ball. Ashok goes wide of the crease and slants the slower ball down leg, Rahul swivels around and helps the pull behind square. That was a poor delivery..

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Ashok Sharma to Rahul, B0$, now sprays it outside off, another off-pace delivery that he does not get right, Rahul leaves and collects the wide

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Ashok Sharma to Rahul, 1 run, 143.1ks back of a length around off, Rahul knocks it to extra cover and quickly crosses over

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Ashok Sharma to Tristan Stubbs, 5 runs, that's unfortunate. Ashok nails the yorker and Stubbs digs it to the left of the bowler. Ashok gets a hand but can't make a clean stop. The duo decide to risk a single. Gill swoops down, picks up the ball and scores a direct-hit at the striker's end. But Rahul was in and the ball deflects away for four additional runs

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Ashok Sharma to Rahul, B0$, Sai goes for the catch and the ball bounces in front of him. Another slower delivery, outside off and Rahul has a swipe across the line. Not off the middle and Sai decided to go for the catch. He charges in and dives forward, but the ball lands short and deflects off him to the fence

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Ashok Sharma to Rahul, 1 run, B0$ High full toss and Rahul was a bit surprised, he does not capitalise and just knocks it to long-on. But has a word with Stubbs and decides to review for a no-ball. It was clearly below the waist..

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Ashok Sharma to Tristan Stubbs, no run, B0$ 105.4ks back of the hand slower ball, Stubbs waits and still can't connect with the slash

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to Rahul, 1 run, low full toss outside off, swirls away a bit and hence Rahul toe-ends the slice to deep point. Washington almost overruns it but adjusts quickly and makes the stop

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to Tristan Stubbs, 1 run, 132.2ks full pitcher, right in the slot and Stubbs drills the drive to mid-off, goes on the bounce and Rashid does extremely well to make a half stop. He moves to his right and slides, gets his body behind and deflects it away, saved three

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to Rahul, no run, 127.5ks slower short ball outside off, Rahul attempts the fancy reverse swat and does not connect

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to Rahul, B0$ Tristan Stubbs Run Out!! This is a massive moment in the game. Rahul said "no, no, no, sorry mate" but it was too late. Another off-pace delivery banged into the pitch, Rahul takes it on and toe-ends the pull to mid-on. He made a start for the single and then backed out. Stubbs was halfway down when he was sent back. He turns around and charges across, dives but is still well short of the crease. Sai does brilliantly to collect the ball cleanly and then fire a direct hit at the non-striker's end. It needed an accurate throw to catch Stubbs short and Sai delivered. B1$

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to Rahul, B0$, full and outside off, tries to keep it away from Rahul's range but it is not within the marker, wide called

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to Rahul, B0$, attempted yorker but Siraj does not keep it inside the guideline, Rahul leaves and pockets the wide

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to Rahul, B0$, mid-on is inside the ring and Rahul takes advantage of that. Siraj does not get the yorker right, allows Rahul to get under and loft it over the infield. Phillips runs around from deep mid-wicket but can't make the stop

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to Rahul, B0$ Caught by Jos Buttler!! Gone! Two wickets in the over but this is a big one. A well-set Rahul is walking back. No hundred for him. But what a knock! Started slowly, found his rhythm as the innings progressed and then struck it cleanly. Delhi Capitals needed him to stay till the end. Siraj gets the wide yorker right - this is full and outside off, just within the guideline and Rahul reaches for the drive, gets an outside-edge and Buttler does the rest behind the stumps. Siraj is pumped and is off on a celebratory run. B1$

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to David Miller, 1 run, back of a length delivery, Miller mistimes the pull to deep mid-wicket

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Vipraj Nigam, 2 runs, 141.5ks back of a length around off, Nigam makes room and slices it over backward point. The ball lands safely and Phillips gets around from sweeper to keep it down to a brace

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Vipraj Nigam, no run, slower short ball, Nigam moves across his stumps and bends low to play the scoop, the ball lobs over him and barely carries to Buttler. The square leg umpire signals one for the over..

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Vipraj Nigam, 1 run, off-pace delivery, Nigam stays leg-side and flat-bats it to long-on

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to David Miller, B0$, much needed boundary. Short of length angled across, Miller has enough space to free his hands, slaps it over extra cover and gets Delhi Capitals the four they were looking

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to David Miller, 1 run, 127.3ks short of length at the body, Miller wanted to pull it backward of square but picks out the fielder in the deep. Just a single and he's disappointed with himself

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to David Miller, B0$, yorker outside off, lands outside the guideline and Miller leaves, wide called

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to David Miller, B0$, that's what Miller can do. He can clear the boundary with ease. Siraj goes slow and short into the wicket, Miller just delays his pull and manages to middle. The ball goes high and 82 meters long towards deep mid-wicket

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to David Miller, B0$, uhhh! That's absolutely hammered. Siraj misses his yorker by a long margin, right in the arc and Miller does not miss out, he pumps it flat and over extra cover. The ball landed close to the ad cushions. The third umpire has a check and decides it is a four

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to David Miller, B0$, oh my! Miller with the no-look shot. He's racing away with the game now. This is Miller at his best. Another length delivery, Miller keeps his head down and swings through the line. The ball flies off the middle and sails over long-on

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to David Miller, 1 run, off-pace delivery, banged into the surface, Miller makes room and pulls to mid-wicket. Phillips sprints in from the deep and keeps it to a single

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to Vipraj Nigam, B0$, Nigam is playing his role. This is the slower bouncer from Siraj, it seemed to be going over Nigam, but he backs away and telescopes it over Buttler. The fielder at third man is fine but not fine enough to stop the boundary. 14 from 7 now..

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to Vipraj Nigam, 1 run, moves away and Siraj follows him with a full toss, Nigam tucks it backward of square and has to be content with a single. That's good for the Gujarat Titans. That was a poor over from Siraj - B0$

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Prasidh Krishna to Vipraj Nigam, B0$, Nigam showing he is no mug with the bat. This is poor planning and execution. With mid-off and mid-on inside the ring, Prasidh goes full and outside off, Nigam stays leg-side and lofts it over wide mid-off, couple of bounces and over the rope. B1$

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Prasidh Krishna to Vipraj Nigam, B0$ Caught by Shubman Gill!! The chat does not work. Nigam goes. Gujarat Titans breathe again. It is not only a wicket but it also keeps Miller at the other end. This should have been the length on the first ball - short and into the pitch, Nigam makes room and reaches for the flat-batted hit, miscues it straight up and Gill backtracks near mid-off, steadies himself and hangs on safely. B1$

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Prasidh Krishna to Kuldeep Yadav, 1 run, that's good from Kuldeep. Prasidh goes round the wicket and angles it in, short of length and Kuldeep calmly opens the bat face, steers it to third man and brings Miller on strike. B0$

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Prasidh Krishna to David Miller, B0$, B1$ - that was the famous saying coined when Miller first came to the IPL. B2$ Another slot delivery, full and outside off, Miller has no half measures while playing these big shots, he lofts through the line and sends it all the way in the parking area at long-off. B3$

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Prasidh Krishna to David Miller, no run, he does not take the single. Short of length angled in, Miller swivels and pulls to deep square leg. Kuldeep was halfway down when he was sent back. Miller wants to do it himself. A single would have been the scores are level and even if Kuldeep had missed, it would have been a tie. B0$ Chat between Gill and Prasidh. Tewatia joins in. Three men out in the deep on the leg-side.

Match_Name: DELHI CAPITALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Prasidh Krishna to David Miller, B0$ Kuldeep Yadav Run Out!! Oh my! Gujarat Titans are celebrating. Kuldeep has been given out run-out. B1$ What drama! It was a slower short ball, Miller missed the pull and the ball goes on the bounce to Buttler. Kuldeep has to go for the single. He does his best - runs and dives but Buttler catches him short with a direct hit. He gathered the ball cleanly and under-armed it onto the stumps. The dive was not enough for Kuldeep and the Capitals. The third umpire is checking for a wide. "Miller's head height is 1.87 meters and the ball has passed at 1.75 meters," informs Saidharshan Kumar. It is a fair delivery and Gujarat Titans can continue their celebrations. B2$

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Shami to Ajinkya Rahane, 1 run, 138.4ks fuller and hint of away swing, Rahane stays rooted to the crease and opens the bat face, guides it down to third man and gets off the mark

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Shami to Finn Allen, no run, 140.4ks shortens the length and swings away, Allen has a loose waft and is beaten on the outside-edge

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Shami to Finn Allen, no run, 139.3ks fuller and shaping away, Allen's feet don't move and he looks to drive, again beaten on the outside-edge. Pant dives to his right to glove the ball. Plenty of swing for Shami..

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Shami to Finn Allen, no run, uhhh! Shami is swinging it both ways. This is the inswinger, Allen charges down and looks to loft through the line, the ball beats the inside-edge this time

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Shami to Finn Allen, 1 run, 140ks back of a length and swinging away, Allen aims to punch and gets a thick outside-edge to third man

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Shami to Ajinkya Rahane, B0$, shot! 137ks full pitcher around off, right in the slot, and Rahane drives through the line. He hits it uppishly and evades the outstretched left hand of Shami

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Prince Yadav to Finn Allen, B0$, 138ks delivery straying down leg, too far for Allen to connect with the glance and the ball keeps swirling as it goes behind, Pant moves across and gets into the tangle, manages to get a glove and stop

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Prince Yadav to Finn Allen, B0$, not convincing but Allen has his first boundary. 136.3ks back of a length angled in, Allen uses the angle and whips it backward of square. The ball races away..

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Prince Yadav to Finn Allen, B0$, back to back fours. Same region and again not off the middle. Fraction short around off, Allen drags it off the inner half and beats short fine to the left

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Prince Yadav to Finn Allen, no run, 136.9ks low full toss on off, Allen drives and picks out extra cover

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Prince Yadav to Finn Allen, B0$ Caught by Digvesh Singh Rathi!! Another failure for Allen. Prince strikes in his first over. LSG have an early wicket. That's a well-judged catch by Rathi. 137.6ks back of a length delivery, swings away a bit and Allen looks to heave it across the line, gets a thick top-edge and the ball flies down to third man. It seemed to be heading over the rope but Rathi steadies himself right on the edge of the rope, stands sideways to his left and takes it with both hands. He was very close to the ad cushions but did well not to step on it. B1$

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Prince Yadav to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, 1 run, 138ks back of a length and swinging away, Raghuvanshi opens the bat face and guides it to deep backward point

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Prince Yadav to Ajinkya Rahane, no run, 136.6ks on a length and close to off, Rahane eases it to cover-point

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Shami to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, no run, 138.9ks full and swings away, Raghuvanshi drives with the movement and finds cover

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Shami to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, no run, 141ks on a length and around off, Raghuvanshi meets it on the rise and creams it straight to cover-point

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Shami to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, no run, 140.3ks good length ball close to off, Raghuvanshi stays back and guides it wide of slip. Marsh dives to his right and makes the stop

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Shami to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, B0$, shot! Three dots and Raghuvanshi decides to do something different. He makes a bit of room and meets the good length delivery on the up, lofts through the line and hammers it over extra cover, one bounce and over the ropes

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Shami to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, no run, 141ks delivery following a backing away Raghuvanshi, no room to work with and he has to settle with a knock to cover

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Shami to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, 1 run, Rathi is on fire with his fielding. He took a good catch and now saves some runs. Slower delivery, in the slot and Raghuvanshi drives it firmly towards mid-on. Rathi dives to his left and parries it towards mid-off

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Manimaran Siddharth to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, no run, flighted delivery on middle, Raghuvanshi pushes it to cover

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Manimaran Siddharth to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, B0$, darted down leg, Raghuvanshi misses the sweep and Pant does not stop cleanly

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Manimaran Siddharth to Ajinkya Rahane, no run, shortens the length and drifts in, Rahane tucks it to square leg

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Manimaran Siddharth to Ajinkya Rahane, B0$, fabulous shot! 99.8ks pushed through, keeps coming with the angle, Rahane comes down the track, gives himself room and lofts it inside out over extra cover. The timing takes it all the way..

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Manimaran Siddharth to Ajinkya Rahane, 1 run, flatter and at the stumps, Rahane turns it to the right of Siddharth and crosses over

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Manimaran Siddharth to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, no run, 98.4ks short of length around off, Raghuvanshi stays leg-side and punches it to cover-point

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Manimaran Siddharth to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, no run, sliding down leg, Raghuvanshi drags the sweep straight to short fine

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Digvesh Singh Rathi to Ajinkya Rahane, no run, 98.6ks short of length outside off, Rahane gets on top of the bounce and mistimes the punch to cover

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Digvesh Singh Rathi to Ajinkya Rahane, no run, 100.4ks fired fuller and around off, Rahane works it wristily and picks out square leg

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Digvesh Singh Rathi to Ajinkya Rahane, no run, uhhh! Flatter and fraction short, Rahane crouches low and aims to pull, ekes out an inside-edge and the ball gets lodged in the back pad

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Digvesh Singh Rathi to Ajinkya Rahane, B0$, Rahane gets this away. Rathi missed his length - overpitched around off, Rahane makes a bit of room and lofts straight down the ground. Not off the middle but enough to beat the long-on fielder

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Digvesh Singh Rathi to Ajinkya Rahane, B0$, back to back fours. Once again Rathi is full in his length, Rahane backs away and opens the bat face, slices the lofted drive over backward point and the ball trickles into the rope

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Digvesh Singh Rathi to Ajinkya Rahane, 2 runs, fuller and drifting in, Rahane works it wide of long-on and scampers back for the second

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Avesh Khan to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, no run, uhhh! Still something on offer for the pacers. Back of a length and in the channel, Raghuvanshi looks to punch off the back foot but the ball nips in to beat the inside-edge

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Avesh Khan to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, leg byes, 1 run, shuffles across and sits down to play the lap/sweep, gets a low full toss and misses the shot, the ball deflects off the pad into the leg-side

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Avesh Khan to Ajinkya Rahane, 1 run, 134.3ks full toss outside off, Rahane creams the drive but Mukul denies him a boundary - dives full stretch to his right and parries it to mid-off. He saved three runs..

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Avesh Khan to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, B0$, short of length outside off, ample width on offer for Raghuvanshi to play the upper cut, he goes over the backward point region and picks up a much needed boundary

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Avesh Khan to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, B0$, Kolkata Knight Riders on the move. Avesh overcompensates with his length - feeds it in the slot and Raghuvanshi desposts it into the stands. Full pitcher around off, Raghuvanshi stays leg-side and gets under the length, lofts it handsomely and sends it sailing over deep extra cover

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Avesh Khan to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, B0$, B1$ Not much wrong with the delivery but a terrific shot. Good length ball close to off, Raghuvanshi gets on top of the bounce and crunches the drive in front of square, finds the small gap between cover-point and cover and picks up the boundary

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Manimaran Siddharth to Ajinkya Rahane, 1 run, 97.3ks drifting in from round the wicket, Rahane nudges it through mid-wicket

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Manimaran Siddharth to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, 2 runs, 99.9ks quicker and fuller, Raghuvanshi drives in front of square and Rathi had some ground to cover from sweeper, easy couple

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Manimaran Siddharth to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, B0$, Raghuvanshi on the move now. This is full and sliding in, Raghuvanshi sits down and gets under the length, sweeps it behind square and beats the fielder in the deep

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Manimaran Siddharth to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, 1 run, flatter and skidding in, Raghuvanshi carves it to backward point and Marsh makes a diving stop

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Manimaran Siddharth to Ajinkya Rahane, 1 run, 102.3ks fired at the stumps, Rahane nurdles it backward of square leg

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Manimaran Siddharth to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, no run, 100.4ks fullish delivery on middle, Raghuvanshi makes room and drives straight to cover

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Digvesh Singh Rathi to Ajinkya Rahane, 1 run, 95.9ks googly around off, Rahane check drives it down to long-off

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Digvesh Singh Rathi to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, leg byes, 1 run, appeal for LBW. Pant and Rathi have a chat. The skipper gestures the impact is outside off. Raghuvanshi attempts the reverse sweep and gets himself outside off-stump. He misses the shot and the ball rolls off the pad towards backward point

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Digvesh Singh Rathi to Ajinkya Rahane, B0$, what timing! Just a clip an the ball races away. Bit more flight on this delivery, drifts into leg-stump, Rahane picks it off his pads and splits the two fielders perfectly in the deep

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Vaibhav Arora to Mukul Choudhary, byes, 1 run, B0$ Look at the celebrations from them. Rathi runs out and hugs Mukul Choudhary. Avesh Khan is running away in delight - arms raised in triumph. Mukul has become the unlikely hero. Angkrish Raghuvanshi had the chance to become a Jos Buttler but he fails to hit direct and the game is done. It's a good delivery, short of length and across Mukul Choudhary outside off, who pulls and Raghuvanshi had the chance to hit direct, had he done so, Avesh could've been short. Yes as I watch it again. Avesh was just short with a direct-hit as he doesn't dive. The keeper tried the over-arm throw and got it wide of the stumps. The ball hits Mukul but by then the game was over. Replays show that Raghuvanshi had the right glove off and showed his disappointment when he missed. Meanwhile Mukul with folded hands looks heavenwards and prays. Avesh with a fist-pump. Russell and Pant both look heavenwards but with contrasting emotions. What a game. What a win for LSG. Two nights in a row - the IPL has produced thrillers. What an advertisement for the league

Narine never got going despite the two sixes and falls inside the powerplay. B1$

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS

Was he put off by Sarfaraz coming near him from deep mid-wicket?

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS
Commentary_Text: Gurjapneet Singh to Ajinkya Rahane, B0$, beautiful shot. Ajinkya Rahane breaking the shackles. Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS

Commentary_Text: Gurjapneet Singh to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, B0$, nice shot. Big over this. A short of length delivery on off, Angkrish Raghuvanshi makes room slightly and uses the pace on that delivery to guide it between backward point and short third man. No fuss, just clever batting

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS
Commentary_Text: Akeal Hosein to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, 1 run, full on leg-stump, Angkrish Raghuvanshi gets forward to defend, the ball hits the leg and rolls in front of backward point for one

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS
Commentary_Text: Akeal Hosein to Ajinkya Rahane, 1 run, B0$ He was charging in and perhaps too quickly for his own good. Gets both hands and drops it. Similar to Brevis' earlier. Hard hands and down it goes. It's a flat good length on off, Ajinkya Rahane tries to swipe across the line, the top-edge flies high and Sarfaraz did all the hard work by running in, but then fails to hang on

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS
Commentary_Text: Akeal Hosein to Angkrish Raghuvanshi, B0$ Caught by Dewald Brevis!! Finally Akeal Hosein gets a wicket. After two drops. Angkrish Raghuvanshi fails to cash in on the earlier drop. It's a flat length delivery on leg-stump, he goes on the back foot and makes room slightly, pulls but there's no power or timing behind that hit. Easy catch for long-on and Brevis reverse-cups with ease. CSK tightening the screws here. B1$

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS
Commentary_Text: Noor Ahmad to Ajinkya Rahane, B0$ Caught by Ruturaj Gaikwad!! Noor Ahmad celebrates by closing his eyes with both hands. KKR fans are downcast. It's tossed up full on middle, Ajinkya Rahane gets forward to loft over extra-cover, inside-out, but he miscues it and that's a simple catch for Rutu who's has gone a few paces outside the 30-yard mark at extra-cover. The bat turned on impact and that's why Rahane miscued that. B1$

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS
Commentary_Text: Noor Ahmad to Cameron Green, B0$ Bowled!! Two in two and the Chepauk crowd are jumping up and down with whistles tooting in their lips. This is bowled from round the wicket. Noor Ahmad changed the angle and pushed it through quicker on middle and leg, good length and Cameron Green backs away to access the off-side, the ball rushes through and misses the bat, falls on the stumps. Green disappoints once again this season with the bat. CSK well on top here. Noor leaps and punches the air as he celebrates. B1$

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS
Commentary_Text: Noor Ahmad to Rinku Singh, no run, four dots in a row. It's flat good length delivery on off, hurries Rinku Singh who goes on the back foot and pushes it to point. No run there

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS
Commentary_Text: Noor Ahmad to Rinku Singh, B0$ Caught by Shivam Dube!! The pressure of the dots. And it has taken Rinku Singh's wicket. He was visibly disappointed with Rovman Powell for not running off the last ball. He felt there was one to point, and next ball he holes out. He backs away and this is full on the stumps, looks to loft, off the thick inside half of the bat and Dube at long-on didn't have to move an inch. Easy catch and this is going from bad to worse for KKR. The camera pans to Abhishek Nayar and Rahane who are seated next to each other. Understandably they are gutted. Powell nervously looked in the direction of long-on as soon as Rinku hit that. Watches Dube catch that. B1$

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS
Commentary_Text: Noor Ahmad to Rovman Powell, 1 run, tossed up full on leg-stump, Rovman Powell gets forward and flicks to deep mid-wicket. He is happy to turn the strike over

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS
Commentary_Text: Noor Ahmad to Ramandeep Singh, leg byes, 1 run, Ramandeep Singh backs away, Noor Ahmad follows him with a length delivery, Ramandeep flicks and misses, a legbye to short fine

Match_Name: CHENNAI SUPER KINGS VS KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS
