Commentary_Text: Xavier Bartlett to Quinton de Kock, B0$, smart batting from QDK. Gets the width he needs and he steers it wide of backward point. Hurried to the fence

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Xavier Bartlett to Quinton de Kock, B0$, cross seam delivery and in the slot. Quinton de Kock gets in a strong position and heaves it over mid-wicket. Gets it right of the screws and the ball sailed deep into the stands

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Xavier Bartlett to Quinton de Kock, 1 run, good length delivery outside off, cut wide of backward point

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Xavier Bartlett to Naman Dhir, 1 run, another full toss missed by Naman Dhir. This time it was the low full toss. Tucked to mid-wicket

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Xavier Bartlett to Quinton de Kock, 1 run, yorker outside off, squeezed to point for a run

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Yuzvendra Chahal to Quinton de Kock, no run, flighted delivery well outside off, de Kock goes for the reverse sweep and misses. Couldn't get anywhere close to the ball

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Yuzvendra Chahal to Quinton de Kock, B0$, B1$ Tossed up wrong'un from Chahal. Quinton de Kock picks it and deposits it over deep square leg with a slog sweep

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Yuzvendra Chahal to Quinton de Kock, 1 run, full and wide outside off, dragged to long-on

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Yuzvendra Chahal to Naman Dhir, B0$, now it's Naman Dhir. Skips down the track and gets to the pitch of the ball to hit it inside out over cover. Goes through with the shot and the timing takes the ball well over the boundary rope

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Yuzvendra Chahal to Naman Dhir, 1 run, looks to charge yet again, Naman Dhir gets too close to the ball. Can't get elevation and he hits it one bounce to long-on

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Yuzvendra Chahal to Quinton de Kock, 1 run, slower through the air, Quinton de Kock hangs on the back foot and pushes it to cover

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Quinton de Kock, 1 run, slower delivery outside off, cut wide of backward point

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Naman Dhir, 1 run, banged in short at the batter's badge. Pulled to deep square leg

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Quinton de Kock, 1 run, goes for the full delivery on the pads, Quinton de Kock tucks it between deep mid-wicket and square leg. Duo settle for a single

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Naman Dhir, 1 run, full and angling across. Naman Dhir drags the ball down to long-on

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Quinton de Kock, B0$, Jansen gets away and a poor delivery down the leg. Comes round the wicket and bowls a full toss outside leg. de Kock fails to get bat on ball

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Quinton de Kock, 1 run, goes for the wide yorker. Quinton de Kock has to drag it from well outside off and hits it to mid-wicket

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Naman Dhir, 1 run, fullish in length on middle, driven hard down to long-off. Just a single for Naman Dhir

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Shashank Singh to Naman Dhir, 1 run, B0$ This has been excellent knock. Promoted up the order after Mumbai Indians lost couple of quick wickets; he was the aggressor in this partnership but now has taken a backseat. He raises his bat and acknowledges the applause of the home crowd. Fullish delivery around off, Dhir drags the drive off the inner half to long-on

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Shashank Singh to Quinton de Kock, 1 run, in the air and safe. Slower ball bowled into the surface, Quinton de Kock has to reach for it and toe-ends the flat-batted hit straight up. Stoinis starts to go for the catch from extra cover but loses sight of the ball because of the light. The ball lands safely behind the non-striker

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Shashank Singh to Naman Dhir, no run, fuller and outside off, Dhir drives sans timing to extra cover

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Shashank Singh to Naman Dhir, B0$ Caught by Xavier Bartlett!! Shashank has this knack of picking wickets. He did it in the previous game against SRH where he picked up Abhishek and Head in the same over. Now breaks this partnership by sending back a well-set Naman Dhir. On a length and outside off, Dhir looks to loft on the up, meets the ball on top of the bounce and creams it flat towards long-off. He did not get the elevation and Bartlett does well to jump up, stretches his hands up and take it over his head. That ball was travelling but Bartlett had it under control. B1$

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Shashank Singh to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, back of a length around off, Hardik drops it beside the pitch on the off-side and crosses over

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Shashank Singh to Quinton de Kock, 1 run, angled across the left-hander, Quinton drives square and retains strike

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Quinton de Kock, B0$, just eludes the sweeper's run. Full toss outside off, Quinton opens the bat face and slices it square. Priyansh sprints to his right from sweeper but the ball lands wide of him and goes over the rope. There were two fielders in the deep - backward point and sweeper cover. Quinton split them perfectly..

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Quinton de Kock, B0$, slower ball outside off, not within the marker and Quinton lets it pass, collects the wide

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Quinton de Kock, 1 run, low full toss angled across, Quinton drags the drive towards deep mid-wicket

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, short of length at the body, Hardik does not have the space to free his hands, gets cramped and mistimes the pull to the vacant mid-wicket region

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Quinton de Kock, no run, full toss slanted across, Quinton winds up for the big mow - moves around in the crease and stays deep, crouches his back knee and swings to the leg-side, the ball sneaks under his bat. He knows he's missed out..

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Quinton de Kock, 1 run, very full delivery outside off, Quinton opens the bat face and slices it over point, just a single

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, short of length delivery, Hardik does not quite middle the pull but gets it away to deep square leg

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Shashank Singh to Hardik Pandya, no run, fuller and outside off, Hardik drives towards extra cover and Stoinis makes a diving stop

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Shashank Singh to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, short and bowled into the wicket, Hardik rides the bounce and chops it to extra cover

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Shashank Singh to Quinton de Kock, B0$, much needed hit for Quinton and Mumbai Indians. There was a quiet period and they needed a move on. Slower ball outside off, plenty of width and Quinton slams it flat over long-off. Flat but high enough to beat a tall Jansen on the rope

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Shashank Singh to Quinton de Kock, B0$, back to back sixes. Was it right to give Shashank an extra over? He had broken the partnership. Length delivery around off, Quinton moves across his stumps and gets under it, heaves it high and well over the deep square leg fence

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Shashank Singh to Quinton de Kock, 1 run, on a length and angled across, Quinton drives to deep backward point

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Shashank Singh to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, back of a length outside off, Hardik flat-bats it to long-off and retains strike

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Xavier Bartlett to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, short of length outside off, does not quite come on and Hardik checks his cut, sends it to sweeper cover

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Xavier Bartlett to Quinton de Kock, 1 run, yorker outside off, Quinton can only squeeze it out to sweeper cover

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Xavier Bartlett to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, 95.5ks off-pace delivery banged into the wicket, Hardik gives everything behind the slap but only toe-ends it towards extra cover. So far so good from Bartlett, just 3 runs

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Xavier Bartlett to Quinton de Kock, 1 run, low full toss outside off, Quinton moves across and drives to long-off

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Xavier Bartlett to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, nice juicy full toss around knee height, Hardik miscues the heave to deep mid-wicket. He missed out there..

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Xavier Bartlett to Quinton de Kock, B0$, B1$ What a statement! Ignored for the first few games of the season, only brought in because Rohit got injured, lost a couple of early wickets but he has played a magnificent knock. Hardik has his hand up. He's as delighted as Quinton. Coming to the ball: Low full toss outside off, Quinton bends down, uses the pace on the ball and reverse laps it fine of short third. That was some shot to reach the milestone

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Hardik Pandya, B0$, Hardik gets into the act. Finally, he was struggling to middle the ball but has sent this sailing over the rope. Back of a length delivery, angled across and there was width for Hardik to free his hands, pumps it down the ground and sends it all the way

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Hardik Pandya, no run, yorker outside off, Hardik fails to dig it out. It was almost a low full toss which Hardik missed..

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Hardik Pandya, B0$ Caught by Xavier Bartlett!! Oh my word! B1$ Even the Mumbai Indians dugout especially Rohit Sharma is stunned by the effort of Shreyas Iyer. The Punjab Kings skipper even gets up and asks the crowd for applause. Jansen angles it across, takes pace off and makes Hardik reach for the big shot. It comes off the toe-end and skies straight back over the bowler. Iyer runs to his left from long-on and leaps sideways, reverse cups it and is airborne (he was outside the rope) when he throws the ball up to Bartlett. The momentum was taking him over the rope and hence Iyer had to release the ball. He spotted Bartlett nearby and lobbed it straight to him while being in the air. Bartlett's name will be in the scorecard but it was all Iyer. B2$

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Sherfane Rutherford, no run, what a yorker, not much Rutherford can do about that other than jam it back down the pitch

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Sherfane Rutherford, 1 run, another pinpoint yorker, Rutherford brings his bat down in time and digs it towards short third

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Quinton de Kock, 1 run, fullish delivery outside off, Quinton eases it to cover and retains strike

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Quinton de Kock, B0$, whoa! Not the first time he has played that shot today. Arshdeep does not nail the yorker, bowls a full toss outside off and Quinton reverse laps it over short third

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Quinton de Kock, 1 run, fullish delivery around off, Quinton drives to long-off

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Sherfane Rutherford, no run, another perfect yorker and Rutherford jams it back to Arshdeep. Three balls for Rutherford and three excellent yorkers

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Sherfane Rutherford, no run, now the wide yorker, Rutherford thinks it is away from the tramline and lets it pass, but it curls in and lands within the tramline

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Sherfane Rutherford, B0$ Bowled!! Cleaned up! Rutherford will walk back thinking that was top stuff. He faced five deliveries and every single one of the them was a yorker. This one tails in slightly, Rutherford gets his front leg out of the way, but the ball curls past the inside-edge and crashes into the middle-stump. Not much Rutherford could have done with such brilliant execution. B1$

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Tilak Varma, B0$, much needed boundary. Arshdeep for once misses his yorker and sprays a full toss down leg, Tilak sits down inside the line and sweeps it to fine leg. No fielder there and the ball races away..

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Vijaykumar Vyshak to Quinton de Kock, no run, 121.7ks slower ball outside off, Quinton flat-bats it back to Vyshak and he makes the stop

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Vijaykumar Vyshak to Quinton de Kock, 2 runs, 120ks pace off delivery, on the shorter side and Quinton drags the pull in front of square, easy couple

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Vijaykumar Vyshak to Quinton de Kock, 1 run, full pitcher outside off, Quinton mistimes the lofted drive to long-off

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Vijaykumar Vyshak to Tilak Varma, B0$, slower ball bowled into the wicket, Tilak waits for the ball to arrive and pumps the pull in front of square, one bounce and over the ropes. It was the knuckle ball and Vyshak didn't nail it

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Vijaykumar Vyshak to Tilak Varma, B0$ Tilak Varma Run Out!! Excellent work by Vyshak. First he goes full and wide with his line and length, Tilak ekes out an inside-edge on his attempted drive, the ball hits him on the body and drops to the off-side. Quinton calls for a quick single but Vyshak is aware. He runs to his right, picks up the ball and scores a direct-hit at the non-striker's end. Tilak was just short of the crease. B1$

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Vijaykumar Vyshak to Quinton de Kock, 2 runs, full and angled across, not quite yorker length and Quinton lofts it straight down the ground. Not off the middle and hence the ball does not race away to the fence

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Deepak Chahar to Priyansh Arya, 1 run, full and swinging into the left-hander, Priyansh offers the full face of the bat and eases it down the wicket. Chahar can't make the stop and Thakur is rushed across from mid-on, he moves across and slides to make the stop

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Deepak Chahar to Prabhsimran Singh, B0$, Prabhsimran is off the mark with a boundary. Too straight from Chahar - attacks the stumps and offers a freebie on the pads, flicked in front of the square and there's no need to run for that

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Deepak Chahar to Prabhsimran Singh, B0$, back to back fours. Short and outside off, there's a deep backward point in place but Prabhsimran did well to evade him, he plays it late and does not overhit the cut shot, opens the bat face and almost guides it behind square

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Deepak Chahar to Prabhsimran Singh, 1 run, on a length and outside off, Prabhsimran steers it with an open bat face to deep backward point

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Deepak Chahar to Priyansh Arya, B0$, Priyansh has his first six of the night. Ample amount of width on offer and Priyansh does not back away, throws his bat on the lofted drive and slices it over deep backward point. Just had enough to clear the fielder

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Deepak Chahar to Priyansh Arya, B0$, sprays it down leg, Priyansh stays inside the line and misses the glance, wide called

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Deepak Chahar to Priyansh Arya, B0$, B1$ He has been very poor with the first over, went for plenty against Rajasthan Royals and has done the same versus Punjab Kings. The knuckle ball is dragged short, Priyansh hangs back and nails the pull over mid-wicket, couple of bounces and over the rope

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Prabhsimran Singh, 1 run, angling into the pads, Prabhsimran stays back and clips it backward of square

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Priyansh Arya, B0$, Priyansh continues to deal in boundaries.. Leg-lined delivery and a touch shot from Priyansh, he allows the ball to arrive and then clips it square on the leg-side

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Priyansh Arya, no run, 117ks slower ball around leg, Priyansh gently turns it to mid-wicket

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Priyansh Arya, no run, 138.3ks yorker outside off, dips right near the crease, Priyansh thinks he can get there on the full and attempts the drive, the ball sneaks under his bat

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Priyansh Arya, no run, off-pace delivery, Priyansh pats it with soft hands to the off-side

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Priyansh Arya, no run, four dots after the boundary. Another 141.4ks leg-lined delivery, giving Priyansh no room to work with, gently clipped to mid-wicket

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: AM Ghazanfar to Prabhsimran Singh, 1 run, slower and at the stumps, Prabhsimran nudges it into the vacant mid-wicket pocket

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: AM Ghazanfar to Priyansh Arya, B0$ Caught by Deepak Chahar!! Ghazanfar strikes second ball. That's the wicket Mumbai Indians needed especially after that expensive first over. Flighted delivery, but the length is too full and that does not allow Priyansh to get under the whip, he tries his best to clear mid-wicket but hits it straight to Chahar, simple catch and Mumbai Indians have a wicket in the powerplay. B1$

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: AM Ghazanfar to Cooper Connolly, no run, 93ks shortens the length and drifts it in, Connolly punches it to extra cover

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: AM Ghazanfar to Cooper Connolly, no run, flatter delivery around leg, Connolly tucks it straight to mid-wicket

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: AM Ghazanfar to Cooper Connolly, no run, sliding across the left-hander, Connolly pushes it off the outer half to cover

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: AM Ghazanfar to Cooper Connolly, no run, 92ks fraction short and outside off, Connolly cracks it straight to Bosch at cover-point

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Hardik Pandya to Prabhsimran Singh, 1 run, B0$ That's a sitter and Bumrah does not hang on. But what is he doing at backward point? Slower short of length delivery, Prabhsimran tries his best to get on top of the bounce and cut, but does not keep it down and hits it to the left of Bumrah. He moves across and gets both hands but does not hang on

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Hardik Pandya to Cooper Connolly, B0$, nicely done! Back of a length and angled across, Connolly uses that angle and steers it behind square, split short third and backward point perfectly

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Hardik Pandya to Cooper Connolly, no run, very full delivery, close to yorker length, Connolly digs it back to Hardik

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Hardik Pandya to Cooper Connolly, B0$, thumped! Back of a length delivery, but there was width on offer, Connolly stays rooted to the crease and pumps it down the ground. Nice, clean strike and the ball sails over the rope

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Hardik Pandya to Cooper Connolly, no run, off-pace short of length delivery, Connolly drops his hands and lets it pass

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Hardik Pandya to Cooper Connolly, 1 run, 134.9ks full toss on off, Connolly slices the drive behind square and deep backward point tidies up

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: AM Ghazanfar to Cooper Connolly, B0$, poor delivery and Ghazanfar is made to pay. He strays down leg and the length too is on the shorter side, Connolly uses his wrists and whips it over long-leg. Right off the middle and the ball sails into the crowd..

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: AM Ghazanfar to Cooper Connolly, no run, flatter and drifting across, Connolly stays leg-side and knocks it to cover

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: AM Ghazanfar to Cooper Connolly, B0$ Caught by Quinton de Kock!! Appeal for caught behind and Quinton too was confident, Mohit Krishnadas raises his finger. Connolly wasn't sure, has a chat with Prabhsimran and decides not to waste a review. Good call because UltraEdge showed a spike. Fired full and outside off, Connolly is drawn into the shot but is a tad late, gets a feather of an edge and de Kock does well behind the stumps. He was not keeping when the innings started, but has taken over from Rickelton. B1$

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: AM Ghazanfar to Shreyas Iyer, B0$, Iyer is up and running with a boundary. Ghazanfar missses his length - full pitcher outside off, Iyer does not need a second invitation, he leans into the drive and creams it through the packed off-side field

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: AM Ghazanfar to Shreyas Iyer, 2 runs, flatter delivery at the stumps, Iyer tucks it through mid-wicket and races back for the second

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: AM Ghazanfar to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, slower and drifting in, Iyer nurdles it backward of square and retains strike

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Shreyas Iyer, no run, 137.7ks angling in from back of a length, Iyer turns it with soft hands towards mid-wicket

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Shreyas Iyer, B0$, that's poor from Ghazanfar. Mumbai Indians can't afford such sloppy work. Back of a length and outside off, Iyer steers it to third man and it goes straight to Ghazanfar, he makes a mess and allows the ball to trickle into the rope

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, slower ball banged into the wicket, Iyer is half hearted into the pull and the top-edge balloons over the vacant short fine, just a single

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Prabhsimran Singh, no run, 139.1ks bouncer right at the batter, Prabhsimran ducks and allows it to sail over him

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Prabhsimran Singh, no run, short of length delivery around off, Prabhsimran hops to get on top of the bounce and fends it with soft hands to backward point

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Jasprit Bumrah to Prabhsimran Singh, B0$, shot! Width on offer and Prabhsimran cashes in. Back of a length outside off, he rides the bounce and punches it in front of square. There was a big gap between backward point and cover, and the ball raced away..

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Shardul Thakur to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, short and pounded into the wicket, Iyer ramps it fine and third man tidies up

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Shardul Thakur to Prabhsimran Singh, 2 runs, on a length and outside off, Prabhsimran meets it on the up and drives it in front of square, easy couple

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS
Commentary_Text: Shardul Thakur to Prabhsimran Singh, B0$, off-pace delivery outside off, Prabhsimran tries his best to reach it but can't, wide signalled

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS PUNJAB KINGS

Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Cooper Connolly, B0$, this one is right off the meat of the bat! 87kph, a proper half-tracker from the young leggie. Connolly goes back to pummel it over cow corner with a pull shot. Yash Punja under pressure now

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Cooper Connolly, 1 run, 95.1kph, short of length outside off, forced to sweeper cover

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Prabhsimran Singh, 1 run, 92.1kph, leggie on a short of length, pulled to deep midwicket

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Cooper Connolly, no run, 92.9kph, googly on a good length and it spins away, Connolly goes back to cut and is beaten by the bounce on it

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Prabhsimran Singh, 1 run, 91kph, round the wicket, flat ball on a length, worked through midwicket off the back foot

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Cooper Connolly, 1 run, round the wicket to the left-hander as well, 98.3kph, quick and flat on leg, flicked to the left of long-on

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Prabhsimran Singh, 2 runs, 94.7kph, Prabhsimran jabs this length ball towards the midwicket region and the batters take two. Jaddu runs to the ball and scores a direct-hit at the bowler's end but Connolly is comfortably in

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Prabhsimran Singh, 1 run, 89.7kph, slower and full just outside off, driven along the ground to long-off

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Cooper Connolly, B0$, 99.1kph, stand and deliver! Jadeja shortens his length, Connolly clears his front leg and stands tall to thump it over straight long-on. The maximum brings up the B1$

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Cooper Connolly, B0$, in the gap and four more! 104.4kph, fired well outside off and Connolly cuts expertly between backward point and short third man. Speeds away to the fence. B1$

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Prabhsimran Singh, 1 run, legbreak on a length, Prabhsimran allows the ball to spin and turns it to midwicket for a single

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Cooper Connolly, B0$ Caught by Donovan Ferreira!! Cooper Connolly goes for the big shot and perishes. Yash Raj Punja roars in delight. 92.5kph, googly on a full length outside off, Connolly goes down on one leg to slog it downtown but ends up slicing it to long-off. Donovan Ferreira settles under the skier to gobble it. Important breakthrough for RR! B1$

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Shreyas Iyer, no run, 92.6kph, googly to Shreyas and the skipper is beaten on the inside edge as he looks to work it into the leg-side. Given not out onfield and the bowler has persuaded Parag to review it. Seems to be missing leg. UltraEdge confirms no bat. Over to ball-tracking and B0$ RR lose a review

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Shreyas Iyer, no run, floated up on a full length outside off, Shreyas gets forward and push-drives to extra cover

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, 94.8kph, quicker one down leg and Shreyas gets off the mark by clipping it through backward square leg

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Prabhsimran Singh, B0$, 91.5kph, drifting down leg. Prabhsimran walks across and gets low to slogsweep it over backward square leg. One bounce and into the fence

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Shreyas Iyer, no run, 88kph, full delivery, driven to cover

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, bit of flight, full on off, Shreyas makes room and gets forward to drive it to long-off

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Prabhsimran Singh, 1 run, 93.3kph, length ball on leg, worked to backward square leg

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Shreyas Iyer, 2 runs, 89.2kph, Shreyas backs away and stabs this length ball with the spin to the right of sweeper cover for a brace

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, Shreyas backs away early again. Jadeja bowls this quicker at 91.6kph. Stabbed to the right of long-off who is quick to get to the ball

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Prabhsimran Singh, 1 run, 92.3kph, drives this full delivery along the ground to long-off

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Prabhsimran Singh, no run, 140.9ks short of length delivery, Prabhsimran rides the bounce and fends it to backward point. He wanted the single but Iyer sends him back quickly

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Prabhsimran Singh, B0$, streaky! But that's what you get with pace. Another short of length delivery, Prabhsimran stays leg-side of the ball and tries the flat-batted down the ground. He gets a thick top-edge and the ball flies over Dhruv Jurel

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Prabhsimran Singh, B0$, that's more like it from Prabhsimran. He shimmies down the pitch, converts it into a fullish delivery and lofts through the line. Mid-off was inside the ring and he clears him easily

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Prabhsimran Singh, 1 run, 142.8ks back of a length delivery, no room on offer, Prabhsimran closes the bat face early and the leading edge rolls into the off-side, this time Iyer responds and they complete the single with ease

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, 144ks full and attacking the stumps, Iyer drives to long-on

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Prabhsimran Singh, 1 run, 124.9ks slower ball on leg, Prabhsimran tucks it into the leg-side and retains strike

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Prabhsimran Singh, 1 run, 93.9ks tossed up on off, Prabhsimran shuffles across and works it towards mid-wicket

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, 92.9ks fraction short and outside off, Iyer cuts and Burger makes a good stop near backward point, just a single

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Prabhsimran Singh, 1 run, B0$ His fourth of the season. He has been consistent and more mature in the way he goes about his innings. He has played second fiddle to Priyansh first and then to Connolly. Now when Iyer was new to the crease, he struck a couple of fours off Archer to keep the scoreboard moving. He raises his bat and acknowledges the applause. Drifting in with the angle, Prabhsimran nudges it into the mid-wicket pocket and settles with a single

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Shreyas Iyer, byes, B0$, what happened there? That's beaten everyone. Flighted delivery, Iyer sees the line outside off and looks to drive, ends up playing outside the line and is beaten on the inside-edge. Dhruv Jurel gets up early and allows the ball to escape through his legs. Some bonus runs for Punjab Kings

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, short and sliding in, Iyer pulls and picks out deep backward square

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Prabhsimran Singh, 1 run, skidding in with the arm, Prabhsimran tucks it backward of square and retains strike

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Prabhsimran Singh, 2 runs, high full-toss and Prabhsimran is taken by surprise, but he still swings hard and gets a thick top-edge. The ball flies over short fine and Punja gives chase. The ball drops in front of him. He was late to react and was not committed to taking the catch. There's a check for no-ball but it is fine..

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Prabhsimran Singh, no run, slower ball outside off, Prabhsimran stays leg-side and swings across the line, misses and the ball bounces on the way to Jurel

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Prabhsimran Singh, 2 runs, now charges down and is met by an off-pace delivery, goes hard on the pull and drags it to mid-wicket. No fielder inside the ring there and the duo scamper back for the second

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Prabhsimran Singh, 1 run, full and angling in, Prabhsimran clears his front leg and drags the heave to deep mid-wicket

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, full and too straight - on middle and leg, Iyer clips it to deep mid-wicket

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Prabhsimran Singh, 1 run, very full delivery around off, Prabhsimran jams the flick to deep mid-wicket

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Prabhsimran Singh, 1 run, comes down the track and Punja shortens the length, punches to long-off

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, 89.8ks dragged short and Iyer shapes to pull, mistimes it to long-on. The ball lands well in front of Archer

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Prabhsimran Singh, 1 run, 91.5ks short and outside off, Prabhsimran reaches and cuts to sweeper cover

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Shreyas Iyer, B0$, the change of bat works immediately for Iyer. He mistimed a pull early in the over but not with the new bat. This is googly which is dragged short, Iyer goes deep in the crease and launches the pull over deep mid-wicket

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, makes room and Punja follows him, cracked square and the sweeper tidies up

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Prabhsimran Singh, B0$ Caught by Riyan Parag!! Second wicket for Punja. This dismissal shows he is a smart operator. He should be if he's picked over an in-form Bishnoi in the XI. Prabhsimran shimmied down the wicket and Punja saw him coming, tosses up the leg-break well outside off and makes Prabhsimran reach for it, the toe-ended loft goes straight up and Parag settles under near extra cover. He takes it safely and ends a fine knock. B1$

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, short of length around off, Iyer tucks it into the mid-wicket pocket and Jadeja chases it down himself

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Marcus Stoinis, 1 run, 85.3ks flighted close to off, Stoinis drives to long-off

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, 107.1ks sliding in with the angle, Iyer works it through mid-wicket

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Marcus Stoinis, no run, 93.7ks slows it up around off, Stoinis punches it firmly to extra cover

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Marcus Stoinis, 1 run, fraction short and outside off, Stoinis cuts it to sweeper cover

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Ravindra Jadeja to Shreyas Iyer, 2 runs, shuffles across and tucks it off the pads towards square leg. Iyer calls for two and gets it comfortably

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Marcus Stoinis, 1 run, 93.8ks drifting into the pads, Stoinis eases it down to long-on

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, 93ks fuller and close to off, driven down to long-off

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Marcus Stoinis, 1 run, 93ks fuller and at the stumps, Stoinis sits down and squirts an inside-edge on the sweep, straight to short fine

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, flatter and fraction short, Iyer cracks it towards sweeper cover

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Marcus Stoinis, no run, slower but the length is perfect, Stoinis defends it down the pitch

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Raj Punja to Marcus Stoinis, B0$, that ruins the over. But still a good spell from the youngster. He finishes with figures of B1$ This is dragged short and Stoinis loves it there, he hangs back in the crease and uses his power to muscle the pull towards wide long-on, just clears the rope

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, off-pace short of length delivery, Iyer waits and flat-bats it straight to long-off

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Marcus Stoinis, 1 run, 135.4ks good length ball on off, Stoinis punches square of the wicket

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Shreyas Iyer, no run, 125.8ks slower bouncer outside off, Iyer was about to take it on but aborts from the shot. Umpire signals one for the over

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Shreyas Iyer, no run, uhhh! He nails the yorker. That wasn't far from the off-stump. Iyer is late in bringing his bat down and the ball sneaks under it, misses off-pole by a whisker

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Shreyas Iyer, B0$, 134.2ks pace on delivery and Shreyas puts it away. Fullish delivery around off, Iyer bashes the drive in front of square and Archer has no chance to stop that from long-off

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, 136.6ks full toss on the pads, Iyer flicks it to deep mid-wicket. He missed out there..

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, 120.6ks slower ball angled across, Iyer is early into the pull and drags it toward square leg

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Marcus Stoinis, B0$, smashed! Length, in the slot and outta here. Burger goes pace on and lands it right in the arc, Stoinis steps across his stumps and deposits the big hit into the long-on stand. 89 meters..

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Marcus Stoinis, B0$, not off the middle but in the gap. Again Burger goes pace on and Stoinis tries to heave it into the leg-side, gets a thick inside-edge and the ball races through the mid-wicket region

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Marcus Stoinis, 2 runs, slower ball bowled into the surface, Stoinis slaps it over extra cover and scampers back before the sweeper tidies up

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Marcus Stoinis, 1 run, wide yorker outside off, Stoinis opens the bat face and squeezes it to deep backward point

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Shreyas Iyer, B0$ Caught by Dhruv Jurel!! This time the change of bat does not work. It had early on but this time Iyer miscues it straight up. The slower ball from Burger, angled across the right-hander, Iyer is deceived by the lack of pace and is early into the shot, gets it right off the toe-end and the ball goes towards short fine. Jurel runs across and takes a good catch. B1$

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Marcus Stoinis, B0$, banged! Slower ball from Archer but it is short and sits up nicely for Stoinis, 118.2ks delivery and Stoinis nails the pull over deep mid-wicket. Another biggie from Stoinis..

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Marcus Stoinis, B0$, back to back sixes. Stoinis is playing a blinder here. 141.2ks full pitcher, right in the slot and Stoinis smokes it down the ground. He clears his front leg and smashes it straight back over Archer

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Marcus Stoinis, 1 run, low full toss on off, Stoinis drives to long-off and takes the single

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Suryansh Shedge, 2 runs, 144.5ks close to yorker length, Shedge digs it through mid-wicket and races back for the second

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Suryansh Shedge, 1 run, 145.9ks low full toss on off, Shedge lofts it on the bounce to long-on. Ferreira collects and sends in a direct hit at the non-striker's end. Shedge wanted a second but was quickly sent back

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Marcus Stoinis, 1 run, 143.1ks short of length delivery, Stoinisknocks it towards extra cover and keeps strike

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Marcus Stoinis, no run, slower ball outside off, Stoinis reaches and does not connect with the slash

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Marcus Stoinis, B0$, too straight from Brijesh - on middle and leg, Stoinis uses the angle coming into him and swings hard, beats short fine to his left and the ball races away. Punja could have done better..

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Marcus Stoinis, B0$, that's an incredible shot. Not much wrong with the delivery - low full toss on off, Stoinis somehow manages to get under it and uses his power to pump it all the way over wide long-on. Sheer power!

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Marcus Stoinis, B0$, B1$ What a knock! He's got there in 20 balls and giving the finishing touches to this innings. This is a high full-toss and Stoinis wants it checked. He signals 'T'. His waist height is 1.09m, ball is 0.82m. That must have slipped out of Brijesh's hand, Stoinis does not miss out as he swings hard and sends it sailing into the deep mid-wicket stand

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Marcus Stoinis, B0$, shot! Another outstanding shot. Brijesh misses the yorker by an inch or so and Stoinis is able to get under it, he bends his back knee and thumps it flat over extra cover, one bounce and over the ropes

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Marcus Stoinis, B0$, B1$ Another full toss from Brijesh, the line is outside off and Stoinis shuffles across, swings hard and drags it off the inner half. Square leg fielder was inside the ring and the ball races past him

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Yashasvi Jaiswal, 1 run, full outside off, swinging away, Yashasvi Jaiswal gets forward to drive in the air but no cover-point, deep point is there and Jaiswal is off the mark. Swing there for Arshdeep Singh which should encourage him

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, no run, that's a good delivery, the outswinging yorker on middle, swings away late, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi brings the bat down and digs it out to short cover

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, no run, another outswinging yorker, swings away from middle to off, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi gets forward to dig it out to the left of short cover

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, B0$, the inswinger and it's not yorker length, a half-volley and angling into the left-hander on middle and leg, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi gets forward and flicks effortlessly over the deep backward square-leg fence. There was a fielder but he was just a spectator

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, B0$, full on middle, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi gets forward and flicks, Shedge runs to his right from deep backward square-leg, dives but the ball slips away. Arshdeep Singh has a long stare at Shedge. Shedge clutches his back as he grimaces

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, B0$, short and wide outside off, width, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi goes on the back foot and cuts, no cover-point and a long gap to extra-cover's right, races away to the deep extra-cover fence. No chance for deep point to his left. Anything slightly off-target and Sooryavanshi just won't let go

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Lockie Ferguson to Yashasvi Jaiswal, 1 run, a fumble from Arshdeep at point and was a tight single but Yashasvi Jaiswal is in. It's full outside off, angling away from the left-hander, Jaiswal gets forward to drive to Arshdeep, who should've stopped

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Lockie Ferguson to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, no run, a wide slip as Lockie Ferguson loses his run a bit, but doesn't pull put, stutters but delivers. A length delivery on leg-stump, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi gets forward to flick and finds mid-wicket

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Lockie Ferguson to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, no run, short and flies over the bat as Vaibhav Sooryavanshi slashes and misses outside off. It was angled away as well

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Lockie Ferguson to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, B0$, pace and it works against Lockie Ferguson. It's a short of length delivery outside off, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi pulls and the top-edge clears the leap on the outstretched left hand of Jansen. Well over

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Lockie Ferguson to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, B0$, paah! What a talent this kid is. Unreal. It's full on the pads, look at the flick. No followthrough and such power in those wrists. A bit of swag as well, he gets forward and the ball sails over the deep mid-wicket fence

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Lockie Ferguson to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, B0$, and take that Lockie Ferguson he says. It's a slower-ball and the knuckle-ball as well, on a length on middle, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi gets forward and lofts through the line, a flat six straight down the ground. Such an eye for the ball this kid has

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Yashasvi Jaiswal, B0$, short of length outside off, Yashasvi Jaiswal goes on the back foot and cuts hard, point dives to his right but the ball slips away and no chance for deep point to his right

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Yashasvi Jaiswal, 1 run, short of length outside off, Yashasvi Jaiswal goes on the back foot and high-elbows the punch, this time deep point is there

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, no run, slower-ball off-cutter outside off, good length, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi opens the face of the bat and gets forward to guide it to backward point

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, B0$, full and the slower-ball disappears. It's full outside off, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi gets forward and heaves all the way over deep mid-wicket. 10 rows back over deep mid-wicket

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, no run, full and seam-up. But going down leg, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi misses the whip, rapped on the pads and going down

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Shubham Dubey, B0$, this he nails. Off-pace slower-ball and outside off, Shubham Dubey shuffles across and pulls, sort of a top-edge and it flies over the deep square-leg fence. Anticipated that Arshdeep Singh would bowl the same ball again and was ready for it. That should be the game-defining hit

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Lockie Ferguson to Donovan Ferreira, B0$, just wide of the dive of mid-off to his right. It's a slower-ball, the leg-cutter and full outside off, Donovan Ferreira gets forward and belts it. Shreyas the man and the power on the shot was immense. Ferreira loved that, points at someone in the dugout with a smile on his face

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Lockie Ferguson to Donovan Ferreira, B0$, B1$. Monstrous hit. A slower-ball and the leg-cutter again, short of length and sits up, Donovan Ferreira gets forward and smashes the pull, way back over the fence. 105m hit and the PK faces tell a story. They know the game is done. Ferreira is a brutal basher of the ball and this was just an example of his six-hitting prowess

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Lockie Ferguson to Donovan Ferreira, no run, short of length and across Donovan Ferreira, seam-up, outside off, he pulls and misses. A rare dot

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Lockie Ferguson to Donovan Ferreira, B0$, seam-up and the short of length delivery flies off the top-edge as Donovan Ferreira gets forward to pull. Extra pace and bounce, Ferreira swings so hard, that's why the top-edge flies over short third man. Just a hit away now

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Lockie Ferguson to Donovan Ferreira, 1 run, slower-ball and the leg-cutter outside off, Donovan Ferreira gets forward and swipes the pull hard and straight to deep mid-wicket

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Lockie Ferguson to Shubham Dubey, 1 run, slower-ball and full on off, Shubham Dubey gets forward to drive and gets it wide of extra-cover for one

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Shubham Dubey, 1 run, slower-ball and wide outside off, Shubham Dubey gets forward to cut and it's miscued. Arshdeep runs in from deep point, had to dive forward, doesn't. Bounces in front of him. Jansen just looks at Arshdeep who turns his back and goes off

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Donovan Ferreira, B0$, B1$. Celebrations in the RR camp. It's a juicy low full-toss on the stumps, Ferreira gets forward and slams it flat and high over long-on. That went skimming off the bat and it's B2$

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Will Jacks, B0$ Caught by Ishan Kishan!! Nitish Reddy gets the breakthrough. A desperate one for SRH. Nitish gets the ball to shape away a touch, Jacks goes for the drive away from his body. The length wasn't there for the shot and the swing takes the outside edge. Flies to Ishan Kishan, who takes a regulation catch. Will Jacks walks off to an applause. B1$

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Suryakumar Yadav, B0$, Suryakumar Yadav gets off the mark with a boundary. A poor delivery from Nitish. Bowls a short delivery well outside off, SKY steers it behind square on the off-side. No chance for the fielder in the deep

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run, good length delivery on off, Suryakumar pushes it wide of cover-point

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Ryan Rickelton, B0$, what a shot that is. Half-volley outside off, Rickelton drills the cover drive past sweeper cover. That sounded crisp as it left the bat. The fielder in the deep had no chance to cut that

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Ryan Rickelton, B0$, Rickelton gets to his B1$ with a trademark shot. Was on the pads, Rickelton flicks it behind square on the on-side. His bat turns as he makes contact, yet manages to clear the fence with ease. Wankhede crowd erupt as Rickelton raises his bat and soaks in the applause

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Ryan Rickelton, 2 runs, very full outside off, Rickelton digs it out wide of sweeper cover. Duo get back for a brace. 17-runs and a wicket off Nitish Reddy's first over

Match_Name: MUMBAI INDIANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD

Crowd applauds as they see Vaibhav Sooryavanshi up on his feet

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS GUJARAT TITANS

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, no run, B0$! 149.7kph short of length delivery flying past Vaibhav's outside edge when he wanted to drive off the back foot. Was late on the shot

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, no run, 145.5kph short of length delivery, Vaibhav defends this short of length delivery towards cover

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, 1 run, edged and it flies wide of the lone slip fielder, again the fine third man fielder enabling GT to deny the boundary. Rushed for pace on the lofted drive, thick edge escapes

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, B0$, smacked! Never allow him to free the arms. Short of a length delivery just outside off stump, Vaibhav gets under the ball and almost hit on the flattest sixes in cricket. Just bounced in front of the deep cover fence

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS GUJARAT TITANS

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, B0$, now he's ready for the yorker and literally flicked the drive straight past the ump. KG slides across into the frame last second at long-on but the ball races away. Gill gave up early at mid-off as he knew he couldn't cut off the angle

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS GUJARAT TITANS
Commentary_Text: Mohammed Siraj to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, B0$ Caught by Arshad Khan!! It's a skiddy bouncer at 146.6kph. Gave it all he had for this ball and unsettled the youngster. No wonder he's roaring with great intensity with the eyes almost popping out of the socket. Always a pleasure for the bowler when he bowls an effort ball with a plan and it works. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi was totally rushed on the pull but this bumper that was around middle and off, top edge flew high and to the right of short fine leg who did well to judge it well and into his hands. B1$

Clearly hasn't been a happy hunting ground for him this year. Shortish delivery from Kagiso Rabada, Jaiswal mistimed the slog, skied it high and GT have their man. B1$

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Axar Patel, B0$, another gimme from Jansen and Axar helps himself to a boundary. Slips it down leg, Axar just needed to get some bat which he does and the ball races away to fine leg

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marcus Stoinis to David Miller, 1 run, 130.1ks short of length on leg, Miller rides the bounce and tucks it backward of square

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Ben Dwarshuis to David Miller, B0$, lovely shot! Short of length delivery, Miller gets on top of the bounce and slaps it in front of square. No chance for Shedge to get around and stop this one

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Ben Dwarshuis to David Miller, 1 run, 132.7ks short and banged into the wicket, Miller pulls to deep mid-wicket

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Ben Dwarshuis to Axar Patel, 1 run, 112.7ks off-pace delivery, Axar cracks it square and picks out Shedge in the deep

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Ben Dwarshuis to Axar Patel, B0$, fabulous shot! This is Axar at his best - when he is hitting towards long-on and deep mid-wicket. This was a back of a length delivery and Axar picked the bones out of that, transferred his weight back and thumped it into the wide long-on stand

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Thakur to David Miller, 1 run, 137ks good length ball around off, Miller chops it onto the pad and the ball rolls behind the stumps, Axar crosses over

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Thakur to Axar Patel, 2 runs, excellent stop by Dwarshuis. 139ks Good length around off, Axar plays it late and steers it behind square. Dwarshuis is fine at third man and he manages to get around, dive and save a couple

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Thakur to Axar Patel, B0$, the runs are coming at a good clip for Delhi Capitals. Axar shimmies down and Yash went short, but it is too short and sails over Axar, no chance for Prabhsimran as well. Some bonus runs added to the tally..

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Thakur to Axar Patel, 1 run, full and at the stumps, Axar flicks it to deep mid-wicket

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Thakur to Axar Patel, 1 run, 110.6ks slower off-cutter, Axar nudges it with soft hands to mid-wicket and Yash chases it down himself

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marcus Stoinis to Axar Patel, no run, short of length angled across, Axar bends down and does not connect with the ramp

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marcus Stoinis to Axar Patel, B0$, yorker around leg, Axar moves inside the line and does not make contact with the glance

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marcus Stoinis to Axar Patel, no run, good length ball, no room on offer and Axar defends to the right of Stoinis

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marcus Stoinis to Axar Patel, B0$, slower short ball outside off, Axar can't reach it and an easy call for the umpire

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marcus Stoinis to Axar Patel, B0$, much needed boundary. Just the two wides from the first two deliveries. But Axar gets hold of the short of length delivery, nails the pull in front of square and splits the two fielders in the deep

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marcus Stoinis to Axar Patel, B0$, B1$ Finally the Delhi Capitals captain has come to the party. It might be a touch late in the tournament but they still have a game to win. He raises his bat and acknowledges the applause. Fullish delivery, right at the stumps and Axar heaves it towards cow corner. Not off the middle but right in the gap

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marcus Stoinis to Axar Patel, B0$, hat-trick of fours. Cross-seam delivery, angled across and Axar saw the width, he throws his bat and slashes it off the outside-edge over short third. Axar and Delhi Capitals on the move..

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marcus Stoinis to Axar Patel, B0$ Caught by Ben Dwarshuis!! Stoinis does the job for his team. He breaks the partnership and sends back a well-set Axar. A fine knock from the Delhi Capitals captain. But he would be disappointed that he couldn't take them over the line. This was full and in slot, Axar clears his front leg and swings hard, does not time it and the ball skies towards long-on. Dwarshuis settles under and makes no mistake. Just when they were getting the impetus into the innings, Punjab Kings have struck. Game back in the balance! B1$

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to David Miller, 1 run, full and angled in, Miller flicks it wide of deep mid-wicket and settles with a single

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Ashutosh Sharma, no run, uhhh! That was close. 135.6ks short of length delivery, Ashutosh is rooted to the crease and playing for the angle, the ball holds its line and beats the outside-edge

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to Ashutosh Sharma, 1 run, 136.5ks on a length and around off, Ashutosh directs it square of the wicket

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to David Miller, no run, ufff! Miller wanted to send it out of the park. But is nowhere close to connecting. Back of a length and outside off, Miller swings across the line and misses by a mile

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Arshdeep Singh to David Miller, 1 run, 136.4ks good length ball outside off, Miller drags it off the inner half to long-on. Excellent over from Arshdeep - just 5 runs. He also finishes a fine spell. His figures read - B0$

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to David Miller, no run, another swing and miss by Miller. 135.9ks good length ball outside off, in the slot and Miller is through the shot early

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to David Miller, B0$, that's more liek it. Another short of length delivery, Miller waits for the ball to arrive, gets on top of the bounce and cracks the pull in front of square. He bisected deep mid-wicket and long-on perfectly

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to David Miller, no run, 118.6ks off-pace delivery, fraction short and Miller is deceived for lack of pace, gets an under-edge on the cut and the ball rolls back to Prabhsimran

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to David Miller, B0$, ufff! Another flat six from Miller. Not the first for him today. Short of length delivery, Miller swivels around and hammers the pull behind square. There was a fielder but he could only watch it sail over him..

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to David Miller, 1 run, 136ks full and at the stumps, Miller whips it to long-on

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marco Jansen to Ashutosh Sharma, B0$, good effort from Chahal but he can't prevent the boundary. Full and outside off, Ashutosh opens the bat face and slices the loft wide of third man. Chahal moves to his right and dives awkwardly, but the ball beats him to the rope. He has hurt his left shoulder in the process..

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Ben Dwarshuis to David Miller, B0$, another flat six off Miller's bat. All three of his sixes have been flat tonight. Slower short of length delivery, sits up nicely for Miller and he delays his bat swing. He meets the ball on the bounce and slaps it over wide long-off

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Ben Dwarshuis to David Miller, B0$, B1$ He's turning it on for the Delhi Capitals. Back to back sixes to reach the landmark. This is a slot delivery and Miller sends it out of the park. He maintains a solid base and launches the ball over the long-on fence

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Ben Dwarshuis to David Miller, B0$ Caught by Prabhsimran Singh!! Six, six and out! This is a massive moment in the game. Miller should have been the one taking Delhi Capitals over the line. But he departs attempting a third six and leaving them needing 41 runs. Back of a length delivery, Miller swings across the line and gets a big top-edge. The ball was up for a long time. So long that Prabhsimran came all the way from behind the stumps and towards short cover to take the catch. It was right next to Dwarshuis but he left it for the man with the gloves. Excellent catch under pressure and that might be a game-clincher. B1$

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Ben Dwarshuis to Madhav Tiwari, B0$, neatly done! Tiwari does not try to overhit this. He hangs back in the crease, waits for the ball to arrive and steers it behind square on the off-side. Used the pace of Dwarshuis and picked up the boundary

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Ben Dwarshuis to Madhav Tiwari, 1 run, angled in from round the wicket, Tiwari nudges it into the leg-side and crosses over

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Ben Dwarshuis to Ashutosh Sharma, no run, charges down and swings wildly, the back of a length delivery takes off and beats the outside-edge. The ball flies through to Prabhsimran and he had to leap to glove the ball

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marcus Stoinis to Madhav Tiwari, 1 run, back of a length delivery, Tiwari tucks it through mid-wicket

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marcus Stoinis to Ashutosh Sharma, B0$, Ashutosh will be the key from hereon. This is another back of a length delivery, not much room on as well but Ashutosh has short-arm jabbed it to wide long-on. He middled it so well that the ball almost went the distance, just bounced inside

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marcus Stoinis to Ashutosh Sharma, B0$, ufff! That's an incredible shot. 130.2s angled in from back of a length, Ashutosh stands inisde the line and laps it over long leg. Just a whip of the wrists and the ball flies over the rope

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marcus Stoinis to Ashutosh Sharma, 1 run, 126.6ks on a length and around off, Ashutosh stabs it into the off-side and calls for a quick single. Stoinis gets around and has a shy at the bowler's end, hit Ashutosh in the process

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marcus Stoinis to Madhav Tiwari, B0$, Tiwari did it with the ball and now he's doing it with the bat. This is a length delivery, angled into the arc and Tiwari goes full-throttle with the heave. Not off the middle but enough to clear a leaping Shedge on the rope

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Marcus Stoinis to Madhav Tiwari, 1 run, moves away and Stoinis follows him, Tiwari goes through with the big shot and squeezes it off the inside-edge. The ball rolls backward of square and the duo cross over. 19 from the over. 36 from the last two overs.

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Thakur to Madhav Tiwari, no run, short of length outside off, Tiwari walks across and swings across the line, the ball flies over the top-edge

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Thakur to Madhav Tiwari, B0$, lovely shot! Yash nails the yorker and Tiwari was up for it, he moves across and opens the bat face, slices it behind square and beats deep backward point comfortably

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Thakur to Madhav Tiwari, 1 run, 137.2ks back of a length around off, Tiwari chops the pull towards mid-on and crosses over

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Thakur to Ashutosh Sharma, B0$, whoa! How has he got so much elevation and distance? Short of length outside off, Ashutosh manages to get the upper cut over square third man. Incredible how he managed to get under the ball and open the bat face to send it all the way

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Thakur to Ashutosh Sharma, B0$ Caught by (sub)Praveen Dubey!! More twist. More drama! Ashutosh wanted to finish it in this over and perishes in the process. Punjab Kings hanging in there. Short of length delivery, Ashutosh does not quite get on top of the bounce this time, the pull comes off the top-edge and the ball skies towards wide long-on. Dubey runs to his right and takes a good catch. B1$

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Thakur to Auqib Nabi, B0$, B1$, that's poor. But it is not easy to bowl with a wet ball. High full toss, well above the waist and Dar does well to whip it backward of square. Delhi Capitals need just 1 run.. B2$ coming up

Match_Name: PUNJAB KINGS VS DELHI CAPITALS
Commentary_Text: Yash Thakur to Auqib Nabi, B0$, B1$ Dar finishes it off in style. This is the highest successful chase at Dharamsala. The Delhi Capitals camp is a happy one. They have been on the wrong side of the result in such close encounters but not today. This win ensures their campaign is not done. Yash cannot execute the yorker - bowls a juicy low full-toss and Dar pumps it down the ground. He gave it everything and the ball travelled the distance

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD

Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Sai Sudharsan, B0$, B1$ Just a fraction too full just outside off, Sai Sudharsan presses forward and creams it through the covers, impeccable balance and timing, found the gap nicely too

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Sai Sudharsan, no run, oh some shape there, full on leg-stump, shapes away as Sai Sudharsan just chips it towards mid-on, that was in the air briefly

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Sai Sudharsan, 1 run, very full outside off, Sai Sudharsan looks to squeeze it through the off-side but gets a thick inside-edge that goes towards backward square-leg

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Shubman Gill, no run, B0$ Looked like quite a casual attempt from Nitish Kumar Reddy in the end. Full on off-stump, Shubman Gill drove it straight back, was through the shot a touch early and it ended up going to Reddy's right. He stuck his right hand out and didn't look fully committed to it, it didn't stick

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Shubman Gill, B0$, B1$ Just a touch wide and Shubman Gill latches on to it, he hangs back and slices it through backward point, it races to the ropes

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Shubman Gill, 1 run, fuller on off-stump, Shubman Gill steps out looking to go downtown and ends up skewing it out towards deep backward point off a thick outside-edge, lucky it didn't fly straight to a fielder

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Praful Hinge to Shubman Gill, no run, full and sliding down leg, just clips a bit of his pad on the way, Ishan Kishan does well to stop it with a dive to his left

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Praful Hinge to Shubman Gill, B0$ Caught by Heinrich Klaasen!! B1$ Soft dismissal for Shubman Gill, got a reprieve in the previous over but he can't really make the most of it. Pitched up on off-stump, Gill was looking to go up and over mid-on but didn't get the elevation, ended up jabbing it straight to Klaasen at mid-on. He took it low down to his left. Neat catch and the GT captain is on his way back, not his night tonight. B2$

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Praful Hinge to Jos Buttler, no run, length delivery just outside off, hint of nip back in, Jos Buttler knocks it into the covers

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD

Commentary_Text: Praful Hinge to Sai Sudharsan, 1 run, short of length on off-stump, Jos Buttler hangs back looking to run it down fine and gets a thick inside-edge that dribbles into the leg-side

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Praful Hinge to Jos Buttler, no run, past the outside-edge! Lovely delivery this, just a fraction short on off-stump, angled in and nipped away off the deck, Buttler had a little poke at it from his crease, lucky not to nick it. There was a slip waiting too

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Pat Cummins to Sai Sudharsan, 1 run, length delivery just outside off, punched out towards deep backward point

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Pat Cummins to Sai Sudharsan, no run, full outside off, Sai Sudharsan prods forward and blocks it into the leg-side, good tight lines from Pat Cummins

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Jos Buttler, B0$, misfield and it costs them four, overpitched on middle-stump, Jos Buttler whips it away through mid-wicket and the fielder lets it straight through

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Jos Buttler, no run, length delivery on off-stump, Jos Buttler hangs back and blocks it into the off-side

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Sai Sudharsan, no run, length delivery on off-stump, punched straight to mid-off

Commentary_Text: Praful Hinge to Jos Buttler, B0$ Caught by Ishan Kishan!! B1$ Another attempted scoop that goes wrong and Buttler departs! Full and just heading down leg, Jos Buttler shuffled right across his stumps looking to scoop, ended up having to reach around and just managed a little tickle through to Ishan Kishan. The umpire wasn't convinced, prompting SRH to go upstairs. Both bowler and keeper seemed quite certain though. A deflection and a huge spike on UltraEdge. B2$

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Praful Hinge to Nishant Sindhu, no run, dug in short on middle, Nishant Sindhu sways out of the way

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Praful Hinge to Nishant Sindhu, B0$, pitched up full outside off, bit of width and Nishant Sindhu drills it through point, lovely control and timing. That should settle any nerves and give him a lot of confidence

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Praful Hinge to Nishant Sindhu, no run, length delivery on off-stump, blocked into the leg-side

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Praful Hinge to Nishant Sindhu, no run, dug in short outside off, Nishant Sindhu looks to ramp it and misses

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Praful Hinge to Nishant Sindhu, B0$, B1$ Nishant Sindhu steps out, Praful Hinge sees him and drops it short but he offers room, Sindhu thrashes it up and over extra cover, nearly sails all the way. Still, it's the lowest powerplay score for GT in this season, SRH have bowled really well

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Sai Sudharsan, no run, hard length delivery on off-stump, Sai Sudharsan mistimes it into the covers, no room to work with

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS SUNRISERS HYDERABAD
Commentary_Text: Nitish Reddy to Sai Sudharsan, 1 run, very full outside off, chipped out towards deep backward point

Commentary_Text: Mukesh Choudhary to Nicholas Pooran, B0$ Mitchell Marsh Run Out!! Well, well! CSK are saying they are not out of this, yet. Both openers gone off successive balls.
