Lhuan-dre Pretorius was nowhere in the frame and he doesn't even bother to wait, keeps running back to the dug-out. B1$

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Prince Yadav to Donovan Ferreira, leg byes, 1 run, shout for LBW, B0$, but LSG have B1$. Very full and tailing back into the right-hander, catches Ferreira low on the front-pad. No bat, but the impact is only in front of leg-stump, it's heading down and they've lost a review

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Prince Yadav to Dhruv Jurel, 2 runs, low full-toss outside off and it's chopped towards backward point. Badoni runs in and then fumbles, allowing a second run

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Prince Yadav to Dhruv Jurel, 1 run, banged in short and at the stumps, Jurel is hurried onto the pull, hit high on the bat and lobbed past mid-wicket for a single

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Prince Yadav to Donovan Ferreira, 1 run, another low full-toss that tailed back onto Ferreira, punched down to long-on for a single

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Mayank Yadav to Donovan Ferreira, leg byes, 1 run, another shout for LBW, but this was easily going down leg. Full and slanting into the right-hander, Ferreira swung across the line and missed, they sneak in a leg-bye

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Mayank Yadav to Dhruv Jurel, 1 run, slower short ball on off, looked like the cutter and it's pulled powerfully past square leg - Prince moves quickly to his left in the deep and keeps them down to a single

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Mayank Yadav to Donovan Ferreira, 2 runs, back of a length and at the stumps, pulled to the right of long-on - they take on Pooran's arm and complete the second run

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Mayank Yadav to Donovan Ferreira, B0$, B1$, Prince has no chance this time around - another slower short ball from Mayank, but it simply sat up to be muscled. Donovan Ferreira does so with power and beats the man in the deep, B2$

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Mayank Yadav to Donovan Ferreira, 2 runs, yorker length delivery on middle, a hint of tail back into the right-hander - Ferreira clears his front-leg and drives it down to long-on, comes back for the second

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Mayank Yadav to Donovan Ferreira, no run, change of pace from Mayank, rolled his fingers across the seam - stayed a tad low and beats Ferreira's swipe

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Prince Yadav to Dhruv Jurel, no run, on a good length and around off, a miscued pull to mid-wicket

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Prince Yadav to Dhruv Jurel, no run, full and at the pads, past Jurel's flick and lobs back off the pad towards the path of the bowler - Jurel wasn't sure about the ball and set-off for a quick single, he turns back quickly and slides back to beat the attempted shy

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Prince Yadav to Dhruv Jurel, B0$, B1$, back of a length and angling into the right-hander - Jurel swivels across, gets inside the line and uses Prince's pace to pull it over long leg, brings up his B2$

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Prince Yadav to Dhruv Jurel, 1 run, low full-toss on middle and leg, punched down to long-on for a single

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Prince Yadav to Donovan Ferreira, no run, fuller length delivery outside off - drilled straight to the fielder at mid-off

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Prince Yadav to Donovan Ferreira, 1 run, a chance and B0$. LSG haven't helped themselves in the field tonight, not that this catch would've have mattered a lot - low full-toss and Ferreira doesn't get any elevation on the lofted drive. Hits it straight to long-on - Pooran ran in, covered good ground and let the ball pop out

Match_Name: RAJASTHAN ROYALS VS LUCKNOW SUPER GIANTS
Commentary_Text: Shahbaz Ahmed to Donovan Ferreira, B0$, B1$, RR win and they strengthen their chances of making it to the playoffs - flighted delivery outside off and Ferreira hammered it off the back-foot, plenty of power behind the lofted drive and the man at long-off can only watch it soar over him

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Anukul Roy to Ryan Rickelton, 1 run, 90.6ks starts with a flatter delivery on leg, Rickelton knocks it to long-on

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Anukul Roy to Rohit Sharma, 1 run, 88.7ks slower and drifting in, Rohit stays back and tucks it to deep square leg

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Anukul Roy to Ryan Rickelton, B0$, there's the first boundary of the game. Fraction short and sliding across, Rickelton waits back in the crease and cracks it in front of square, pierces a packed off-side field

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Anukul Roy to Ryan Rickelton, no run, 95.3ks sliding across off, Rickelton closes the bat face and the leading edge rolls to short third

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Anukul Roy to Ryan Rickelton, no run, 94.5ks fired in around leg, Rickelton gently turns it to mid-wicket

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Anukul Roy to Ryan Rickelton, no run, appeal for LBW. Raghuvanshi was confident, Rahane has a word with him and decides against the review. Rickelton misses the sweep and is rapped on the pads. But the ball had pitched outside leg

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Saurabh Dubey to Rohit Sharma, no run, back of a length around off, Rohit gets behind the line and defends to the left of Dubey

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Saurabh Dubey to Rohit Sharma, no run, ouch! Another back of a length delivery and Rohit winds up for a mow to the leg-side, misses and is struck on the box. He goes down in pain and takes a bit of time to stand back up

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Saurabh Dubey to Rohit Sharma, 1 run, 129.5ks good length ball around off, Rohit opens the bat face and guides it to deep backward point

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Saurabh Dubey to Ryan Rickelton, B0$, bit of swing for Dubey. It is short and swings away outside off, no chance for Rickelton to reach that

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Saurabh Dubey to Ryan Rickelton, 1 run, fumble by Pandey. Short and outside off, Rickelton cuts to cover-point and Pandey does not get down quickly, only manages fingertips and the pair cross over

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Saurabh Dubey to Rohit Sharma, no run, 130.8ks yorker aimed for the base of middle, Rohit clears his front leg and digs it back to Dubey

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Saurabh Dubey to Rohit Sharma, leg byes, 1 run, 130ks strays down leg, Rohit fails to help it along and the ball deflects off the under side of thigh pad. Rickelton calls for a quick single and makes it in before Raghuvanshi's throw passes the stumps

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Cameron Green to Rohit Sharma, B0$, high and long! 136.5ks back of a length delivery, Rohit picks the length early and heaves it over backward square leg. It is the shortest boundary there - 58 meters - and he clears it comfortably

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Cameron Green to Rohit Sharma, 1 run, uhhh! 136.2ks short of length around off, Rohit rides the bounce and tries to punch through the off-side, ekes out an inside-edge and the ball passes the stumps

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Cameron Green to Ryan Rickelton, B0$ Caught by Manish Pandey!! If Kolkata Knight Riders needed one fielder under the skier it would have been Pandey. This was a tough catch and Pandey hangs on. Green goes round the wicket - hits the hard length and angles it in, Rickelton goes for his favourite shot - pick-up over square leg, but is early and the leading edge goes high into the night sky. The ball took a while to come down. Pandey circled under it from cover-point, kept his eyes on the ball and took it safely with both hands. B1$

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Cameron Green to Naman Dhir, no run, on a length and outside off, Dhir has a tentative poke and is beaten on the outside-edge

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Cameron Green to Naman Dhir, no run, 137ks fuller than good length and outside off, Dhir reaches for a push and is beaten again. The ball does not carry to Raghuvanshi

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Cameron Green to Naman Dhir, B0$ Caught by Angkrish Raghuvanshi!! Third time lucky for Green. He beat the outside-edge the last two balls and this time finds it. Once again it is the line and length - fulish delivery around off, draws Dhir into the push and it is a tentative one. The ball kisses the outside-edge and Raghuvanshi does the rest behind the stumps. Dhir walks off shaking his head. There was a clear noise and UltraEdge also showed a small spike, so not sure what disappointed Dhir there. B1$

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Saurabh Dubey to Rohit Sharma, no run, uhhh! Now Dubey goes past the outside-edge. Good length ball angled across, Rohit prods forward and goes searching for the ball, almost nicks it behind

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Saurabh Dubey to Rohit Sharma, no run, whoa! That's an absolute peach. Rohit decides to give the charge and put Dubey off. But he shortens the length and gets it to nip away late, Rohit is squared up and the ball just misses the outside-edge. Half an appeal from Raghuvanshi but nothing from Dubey

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Saurabh Dubey to Rohit Sharma, B0$, nicely done! Fuler and slanted across, Rohit kneels down with his front leg planted outside off, he fetches it from there and laps it all the way over fine leg

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Saurabh Dubey to Rohit Sharma, no run, back of a length and no room on offer, Rohit hops and tucks it with soft hands to mid-wicket

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Saurabh Dubey to Rohit Sharma, B0$ Caught by Cameron Green!! KKR on a fire! They are catching everything and have Mumbai Indians reeling. Dubey rolled his fingers across this one, the length was full and Rohit thought he could heave it into the leg-side, but mistimes completely and the ball flies over mid-wicket. Green runs back, keeps his eyes on the ball and takes it calmly. That was not an easy catch but Green made it look easy. Mumbai Indians in trouble. B1$

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Saurabh Dubey to Tilak Varma, B0$, fuller and swinging away, Tilak sees it way outside off and lets it go. Wide called

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Saurabh Dubey to Tilak Varma, no run, back of a length around off, Tilak is opened up as he defends down the pitch

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Cameron Green to Suryakumar Yadav, B0$, lovely shot! Suryakumar gets off the mark with a glorious shot. Full pitcher close to off, Suryakumar presents the full face of the bat and drives it straight down the ground. That should make him feel confident

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Cameron Green to Suryakumar Yadav, B0$, back to back fours. Suryakumar shuffles across and Green angles it down, that's bread and butter for Suryakumar, helps it along to fine leg and watches the ball race away

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Cameron Green to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run, back of a length delivery, Suryakumar opens the bat face and guides it to deep backward point

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Cameron Green to Tilak Varma, no run, short of length angled in, bit of extra bounce and Tilak looks to defend, gets hit high on the bat and the ball drops into the off-side

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Cameron Green to Tilak Varma, 1 run, 138.7ks on a length and around off, Tilak dabs it through backward point and opens his account

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Cameron Green to Suryakumar Yadav, no run, 138.4ks low full toss around off, Suryakumar almost falls over as he digs it back to Green

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Saurabh Dubey to Tilak Varma, 1 run, on a length and outside off, Tilak dabs it to deep backward point

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Saurabh Dubey to Suryakumar Yadav, B0$, Suryakumar is looking in good touch here. Another finger-roller from Dubey, but the line is on leg-stump, Suryakumar stays inside the line and laps it over fine leg

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Saurabh Dubey to Suryakumar Yadav, B0$ Bowled!! Dragged on! This is a massive wicket. Suryakumar was looking good but he's gone. Mumbai Indians slip further. Dubey changes the angle - goes round the wicket - bowls a 128.6ks fullish delivery, Suryakumar sees the width and goes hard on the drive. The feet don't move and the under-edge ricochets onto the stumps. Smart from Dubey to go round the wicket and make Suryakumar hit through the off-side. B1$

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Saurabh Dubey to Hardik Pandya, no run, first ball and Hardik gives the charge. He swings hard and does not connect. Almost swung off his feet..

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Saurabh Dubey to Hardik Pandya, B0$, short and outside off, Hardik throws his bat on the slash and slices it behind square. No one at deep backward point and the ball almost goes the distance, just bounces inside. He's come out with intent..

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Saurabh Dubey to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, back over the wicket and shortens the length, Hardik shuffles across and tucks it behind the wicket

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Kartik Tyagi to Hardik Pandya, no run, full and at the stumps, Hardik flicks and picks out mid-wicket

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Kartik Tyagi to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, 136.9ks angling into the pads, Hardik clips it backward of square leg

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Kartik Tyagi to Tilak Varma, no run, bouncer and it is well-directed, Tilak watches it all the way and ducks under. Umpire signals one for the over

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Kartik Tyagi to Tilak Varma, 2 runs, just over cover. Tilak charges down and is met by a shortened length, flays it over Rahane and Anukul gets around from sweeper, stops it with his boot and saves a couple

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Kartik Tyagi to Tilak Varma, 1 run, short of length delivery, Tilak hops and fends it with soft hands towards point

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Kartik Tyagi to Hardik Pandya, no run, 144.1ks back of a length outside off, Hardik slashes and is beaten on the inside-edge. The ball did not bounce as much as Hardik expected it to, does not carry to Raghuvanshi

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Tilak Varma, no run, uhhh! Spin straightaway. Tossed up, pitches around leg and spins away, Tilak prods forward to defend but does not account for the turn, beaten neck and crop

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Tilak Varma, 1 run, 92.7ks leg-lined delivery, Tilak nurdles it backward of square leg

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, 96.4ks quicker and fuller, Hardik eases it wide of cover and the duo nab a quick single

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Tilak Varma, byes, B0$, that's beaten everyone. Another ripping off-break, Tilak tries to defend from the crease, the ball spins away to beat the outside-edge and Raghuvanshi is beaten as well. The ball races away past the keeper and Pandey

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Tilak Varma, no run, carrom ball and that too straightens, Tilak is rooted to the crease and misses the tuck, the ball beats the inside-edge and strikes him on the thigh. The bounce saved him there

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Tilak Varma, 1 run, flatter delivery at the stumps, Tilak nudges it through the mid-wicket region

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Tilak Varma, no run, short of length around off, Tilak rides the bounces and knocks it towards mid-wicket. There was a single on offer as Varun runs gingerly to pick up the ball

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Tilak Varma, 2 runs, 95.5ks short of length delivery, Tilak mistimes the pull in front of square and scampers back for the second

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Tilak Varma, no run, drifting across the left-hander, Tilak opens the bat face and guides it to short third

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Tilak Varma, no run, now attempts the reverse sweep and does not quite middle it, picks out backward point

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Tilak Varma, 1 run, 99.7ks leg-lined delivery, Tilak tucks it backward of square

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, 95ks flatter and fraction short, Hardik punches wide of cover and retains strike

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, starts with a carrom ball around leg, Hardik leans across and closes the bat face, the leading edge rolls away square of the wicket

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Tilak Varma, no run, continues to go past Tilak's outside-edge. Another off-break, bowled at 86.8ks which much slower than his average speed, Tilak leans forward to defend but the ball spins across to miss the outside-edge

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Tilak Varma, no run, 86ks flighted delivery on leg, Tilak somehow manages to block it down near his feet

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Tilak Varma, 1 run, 85.1ks off-break that spins across, Tilak pats it with soft hands towards point

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Hardik Pandya, no run, uhhh! That's a peach. The carrom ball and Hardik did not pick it, he presses forward and closes the bat face thinking the ball will spin in, it straightens and beats the outside-edge

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, 96.3ks drifting into the pads, Hardik flicks it past Rahane at short leg and keeps strike

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, sliding into middle and leg, Hardik clips it to deep square leg

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Tilak Varma, no run, he's struggling here. Googly that spins away, Tilak looks to reverse sweep and does not make contact

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Tilak Varma, 1 run, too straight - on middle and leg, Tilak nudges it through mid-wicket

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, on a length and around off, Hardik guides it behind square and Narine stops near short third

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Tilak Varma, 1 run, B0$ Varun had taken the catch but Raghuvanshi collides into him, takes him down and the ball pops out. Varun is not happy. He's suggesting that it was his catch and he called for it. The wrong 'un and Tilak sees the length, which is fuller and sits down to play the slog sweep, but the ball spins away and flies off the top-edge. Varun does well to move towards his left and gets under the ball, catches with both hands but Raghuvanshi spoils it for him. He runs all the way from behind the stumps and bumps into him

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Hardik Pandya, no run, spinning into the pads, Hardik misses the clip and is struck down leg

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Tilak Varma, no run, defended to the off-side

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Tilak Varma, B0$, Tilak breaks the shackles. This was flighted around off, the length allowed him to get under the slog sweep and he absolutely nails it over deep mid-wicket. Much needed hit for him and Mumbai Indians..

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Tilak Varma, no run, spinning across the left-hander, Tilak stays back and stabs it to the off-side

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Tilak Varma, no run, shortens the length and spins it across, Tilak turns it to the left of Narine

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Tilak Varma, no run, once more no room or pace to work with, Tilak knocks it to the leg-side where Narine tidies up

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Sunil Narine to Tilak Varma, no run, now the one that straightens, Tilak is rooted to the crease and does not pick it, the leading edge rolls to backward point

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Hardik Pandya, no run, on the fuller side around off, Hardik Pandya looks to push this through the off-side, doesn't middle it though

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Hardik Pandya, B0$, short and punished! Was fraction short by Varun Chakaravarthy, Hardik Pandya swivel-pulls this over deep square leg and just manages to clear the fielder near the boundary

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, Varun Chakaravarthy goes full and Hardik Pandya smashes it to long-on on the bounce

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Tilak Varma, no run, flatter through the air around off, Tilak Varma mistimes his punch towards cover

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Tilak Varma, 1 run, tad short outside off, slides along the deck, Tilak Varma chops it into the off-side for a single. A throw at the bowler's end, but doesn't hit

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS
Commentary_Text: Varun Chakaravarthy to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, full and straight at the stumps, Hardik Pandya swings across the line hard, only manages to get a single at wide long-on. Couldn't middle it as he went too hard at it

Match_Name: KOLKATA KNIGHT RIDERS VS MUMBAI INDIANS

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Matthew Short, B0$ Caught by Prasidh Krishna!! Wickets keep tumbling for CSK. Was a good length ball from Rabada. Short tries to go over the in-field. Gets it off the inside half of the blade and lobs to Prasidh, who takes his second catch of the night. CSK are looking down the barrel. B1$

Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Dewald Brevis, 1 run, short and into the ribs at 148ks. Dewald Brevis tries to flick and gets an inside edge onto the thigh pad

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Kartik Sharma, no run, good length delivery in the channel outside off, defended to the off-side

Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Kartik Sharma, B0$, through the gap. Kartik gets an inside edge as he looks to dab it behind square on the off-side. Splits the gap between short third and backward point. Rabada isn't happy and hangs his head back in disappointment

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshad Khan to Dewald Brevis, 1 run, low full toss on off, Brevis drives it straight to mid-off

Commentary_Text: Arshad Khan to Kartik Sharma, no run, 143.8ks delivery across the right-hander, Kartik Sharma gets beaten on the outside edge

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshad Khan to Kartik Sharma, B0$, picked off the pads. Full and into the pads, Arshad pays the price. Flicks it over mid-wicket and collects four

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshad Khan to Kartik Sharma, B0$ Kartik Sharma Run Out!! CSK lose half their side. A needless run-out. Kartik was on the back foot as he attempted the shot. Hits it hard and straight to Gill at mid-off, who picks the ball and fires in a direct-hit at the non-striker's end. Kartik puts in a desperate dive, but fails to ground the bat. Was in the air as the bails get dislodged and the gaint screen displays OUT. B1$

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Jason Holder to Shivam Dube, 2 runs, angled across the left-hander, Shivam Dube chips it over cover and collects a brace

Commentary_Text: Jason Holder to Dewald Brevis, 1 run, good length delivery on middle, pushed to sweeper cover

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Jason Holder to Shivam Dube, 1 run, hit hard and just over Gill, who got one hand to the ball, but failed to hang onto the catch. Was short and outside off, Shivam Dube flat bats it to mid-off. Gill was on the edge of the circle, leaps with his right hand and tries to catch it one handed. Could have gone with both hands. B0$

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshad Khan to Shivam Dube, B0$, short and wide and Dube goes through with the shot. Clears his front leg and smokes the cut over point. Flat and over the fence

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshad Khan to Shivam Dube, B0$, this wasn't a bad ball. Probably a touch of width for Dube to free his arms. He flat bats it over mid-off. One bounce and into the fence

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshad Khan to Shivam Dube, B0$, banged in short at the badge. Dube sinks low. Wide called for height

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshad Khan to Shivam Dube, B0$, too straight from Arshad and pays the price. Dube shuffles across and flicks it fine. Beats short fine and there is no protection the deep. 15 runs off the over so far with three ball remaining

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshad Khan to Shivam Dube, B0$, angled well down the leg, wided by the umpire

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshad Khan to Shivam Dube, 1 run, yorker on off, Dube digs it down to long-on

Commentary_Text: Arshad Khan to Dewald Brevis, 1 run, full on middle and leg, tucked to deep mid-wicket

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Arshad Khan to Shivam Dube, 1 run, angled in on the pads, tucked to the on-side

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Jason Holder to Shivam Dube, B0$, short and outside off, Dube wasn't in great control. He goes for the cut and hits it wide of diving third man fence for another four

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Jason Holder to Shivam Dube, no run, yorker on off, Dube jams it out to cover

Commentary_Text: Jason Holder to Shivam Dube, B0$, Dube is not going down without a fight. Picks the length early and pulls it deep into the cow corner stands. 85meters this time

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Jason Holder to Shivam Dube, 1 run, short again and wider of off, pulled to the right of deep mid-wicket. One bounce to the fielder

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Jason Holder to Dewald Brevis, 1 run, pin-point yorker on middle and leg, Brevis digs it out to the right of diving Holder, who tries to stop in his followthrough

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Rashid Khan to Dewald Brevis, 1 run, 95.1ks quicker and attacking the stumps, Brevis knocks it to the right of Rashid and down to long-on

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Rashid Khan to Shivam Dube, B0$, Dube continues to deal in boundaries.. First ball against Rashid and he launches him into the crowd. This leg-lined as Rashid tries to cramp him for room, but Dube opens his body and heaves it over deep square leg

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Rashid Khan to Shivam Dube, B0$ Caught by Shubman Gill!! Gill takes a terrific catch. Throws the ball up, points his finger to the lips and gestures to the CSK supporters to be silent, even asks them to get going. Dube lives by the sword and dies by it. Rashid changes the line to outside off, it was also the googly and Dube had to reach for the lofted shot, he gets it off the toe-end and the ball flies over extra cover. Gill runs back and dives to hang on with both hands. That will be one of the contenders for catch of the tournament. A good knock from Dube but CSK needed more than that from him. B1$

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Rashid Khan to Anshul Kamboj, no run, googly around off, Kamboj prods forward and defends to the off-side

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Rashid Khan to Anshul Kamboj, B0$, now Kamboj wants a piece of Rashid. This is given bit more flight and Kamboj is down on his knee, gets under the length and slog sweeps to deep mid-wicket, just clearing the leaping fielder

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Rashid Khan to Anshul Kamboj, 1 run, in the air and safe. Flatter and skidding on, Kamboj looks to loft down the ground and gets it high on the bat, the ball goes straight up and over Rashid. Holder runs back from cover and dives but the ball evades his grasp

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Prasidh Krishna to Anshul Kamboj, B0$, Kamboj greets Prasidh with a maximum. Back of a length delivery, just had a bit of width for Kamboj to free his hands, pumps the pull wide of long-on and just clears the rope

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Prasidh Krishna to Anshul Kamboj, B0$, back of a length close to off, Kamboj swings hard and drags it off the inner half. The ball goes backward of square and races away to the fence

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Prasidh Krishna to Anshul Kamboj, 1 run, 146.7ks full and at the stumps, Kamboj flicks it to deep square leg

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Prasidh Krishna to Dewald Brevis, 1 run, 142.2ks full toss on off, Brevis swings hard and drags to deep backward square

Commentary_Text: Prasidh Krishna to Anshul Kamboj, 1 run, 142.4ks short of length delivery, Kamboj takes it on and mistimes the pull over backward square leg

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Prasidh Krishna to Dewald Brevis, no run, 147.7ks yorked aimed for middle, Brevis can only dig it back to Prasidh

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Rashid Khan to Anshul Kamboj, B0$ Caught by Jason Holder!! The fun ends for Kamboj. He was never going to hang around. Rashid knew that and smartly bowls the leg-break outside off, Kamboj reaches for the big shot and slices it towards point. Holder moves to his right and takes a good catch. CSK are 7 down and are staring at a big defeat. B1$

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Rashid Khan to Noor Ahmad, no run, uhhh! How has that missed the stumps? Noor hangs back to defend and the leg-break straightens enough to beat the outside-edge, wasn't far from the off-stump

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Rashid Khan to Noor Ahmad, 1 run, premeditates the reverse sweep and has to adjust, ends up swatting it square on the off-side

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Rashid Khan to Dewald Brevis, B0$, 95.5ks throws it up outside off, Brevis leaves and collects the wide

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Rashid Khan to Dewald Brevis, B0$ Caught by Jason Holder!! Third wicket for Rashid. Brevis was at the other end witnessing the mayhem by Dube and Kamboj, tries to join the party and perishes in the process. Once again clever bowling from Rashid. He shortens the length and rushes Brevis on the cross-batted shot, the ball hits the splice and goes straight up. Holder settles under it near cover and completes a dolly. B1$

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Rashid Khan to Mukesh Choudhary, 2 runs, spinning into leg, Mukesh hangs back and squeezes it off the inside-edge to fine leg, easy brace

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Rashid Khan to Mukesh Choudhary, no run, short and turning in, Mukesh misses the pull and is struck around the thigh

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Noor Ahmad, no run, short of length delivery, Noor opens the bat face and guides it to backward point

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Noor Ahmad, no run, 142.4ks short of length outside off, Noor throws his bat and is beaten on the outside-edge

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Noor Ahmad, B0$ Caught&Bowled!! Rabada was brought on exactly for this. Gujarat Titans are one wicket away from a massive win. Short and well-directed, right at the body and Noor is cramped for room, fends it off the splice and the ball lobs up, Rabada goes forward and takes a simple catch. B1$

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS CHENNAI SUPER KINGS
Commentary_Text: Kagiso Rabada to Spencer Johnson, B0$ Caught by Jos Buttler!! B1$ Thumping win for GT by 89 runs. They have done their bit to seal a top-two finish. The fireworks go off in the stadium. Back of a length and angled across, Johnson stays leg-side and has a tentative poke, there's a thin outside-edge and Buttler does the rest. But he wasn't convinced, Rabada was and Gill went with his bowler's call to challenge the onfield decision. B2$

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Abhishek Sharma, no run, nice outswinger finishing around off stump from good length. First signs of ball nicely coming on and Abhishek Sharma absolutely middled that defence. Had it been a couple of yards either side of the man at cover would have been four. All he did was just defend and it raced

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Abhishek Sharma, B0$, rare wayward ball early on from Bhuvi and great work from Jitesh Sharma to dive full length to the right and get a hand on it to save three runs. Bhuvi wanted to surprise Abhishek with the inswinger this time but fired it down the leg-side

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Travis Head, B0$, creamed off the back foot. Third man is pretty square but Travis Head has cut this very straight of point and the timing is good. Bhuvi guilty of letting the batter play on the back foot with a shortish ball that had some width as well

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Travis Head, no run, there's the troublesome outie that Travis Head that usually dances to when a right-armer angles it across him from over the wicket. He got opened up but managed to defend

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Travis Head, 1 run, now for some whippage by getting inside the line slightly! Length delivery on the stumps, Head flicks it through backward square leg, there is protection in the deep

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Abhishek Sharma, B0$, slapped off the back foot and it sailed over long-off. Never allow this man to access the off-side by freeing his arms. Loves hitting over the top and this time he hit it wide of long-off for the first six of the day

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Abhishek Sharma, no run, now looks pace off, Abhishek didn't read the change of pace but managed to keep it out

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Josh Hazlewood to Travis Head, 2 runs, the hard length straightaway to his Aussie teammate. No room for Head to play the pull but he goes through and drags it past square leg off the inside half of the bat

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Josh Hazlewood to Travis Head, no run, short of length delivery cramping him for room again, Head works it to mid-on

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Josh Hazlewood to Travis Head, 1 run, Hoff knows he can't overpitch or bowl too short to this man. Three great balls where Travis Head tried to break-free but couldn't as he had no room to play with. Played to deep backward point

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Josh Hazlewood to Abhishek Sharma, 1 run, it's been nothing but back of a length from Josh Hazlewood so far, Abhishek guides this with an angled bat and almost gets four, wide third man just enters the frame to save three

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Josh Hazlewood to Travis Head, no run, the first change in length. Full and around leg stump, again cramping him there. Travis Head wanted to swing it over the infield, catches the inside half of the bat and rolls to mid-on. Head throws his head back in disappointment that he couldn't score off this ball

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Josh Hazlewood to Travis Head, B0$, and finally Travis Head manages to get under one ball in this over and he pulls it over mid-wicket. Hoff just missed his hard length by an inch or so but that's all these monster hitters need these days. Belted over the infield to spoil the over but still a very good over from Josh Hazlewood

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Abhishek Sharma, B0$, flicks, but tries to be too cute and thankfully for SRH and Abhishek Sharma Krunal was quite wide at fine leg and he couldn't get there for the catch running to the right or deny the boundary. Length delivery on the pads, Abhishek flicks in the air and escapes as he found the gap

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Abhishek Sharma, B0$, now he's hit this over mid-wicket. Bhuvi tries the wobble seam ball, that's a sign he thinks it's not swinging any more. Abhishek stays leg-side and sends it over the infield for four more

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Abhishek Sharma, 1 run, Abhishek steps out while backing away, Bhuvi smartly follows him and only allows a nudge behind square for a run

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Travis Head, 1 run, Travis Head loses shape and mistimes this to deep mid-wicket

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Abhishek Sharma, 1 run, again Abhishek Sharma literally backed away and met that outside the pitch. He wants to access the off-side as there is no one in the deep, but Bhuvi is hell bent on not giving him room and it's a tuck to the on-side

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Travis Head, 1 run, slower ball on the pads, Head tickles it fine, Jitesh once again dives to the right and saves a boundary

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Rasikh Salam Dar to Travis Head, B0$, na, na! Not the start RCB would have wanted from Rasikh Salam Dar. First real bad ball of the game. Man up at fine leg and he bowled this short around leg stump for Head to have an easy flick behind square

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Rasikh Salam Dar to Travis Head, B0$, brilliant back foot punch! Backed away, Head had his base set and quite solid. Rasikh Salam Dar bowled short of length but Head was able to free the arms and go hard on the punch, splits mid-off and extra-cover

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Rasikh Salam Dar to Travis Head, no run, oh the slower ball, Head drills it hard but picks out extra-cover

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Rasikh Salam Dar to Travis Head, B0$, oh good ball and equally well played. Travis Head again stepped away from the stumps, Rasikh bowled a dipping low full toss, Head managed to reach out, adjust and cream the drive to the left of the man at extra-cover this time

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Rasikh Salam Dar to Travis Head, no run, goes for the yorker, just misses the mark, Head mistimes to mid-off

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Rasikh Salam Dar to Travis Head, B0$ Bowled!! This is a brilliant yorker. You could see him try it the previous ball because Travis Head was coming hard at it. He switched to death bowling as he felt that's his best defence ball. He didn't quite nail it and bowled slightly outside off stump previous ball but got it pinpoint at the base of off stump. What a sight for a fast bowler to see the stump being uprooted when the batter is trying to win you over and your plan works. Rasikh gestures with his right hand around the ear that he wants to hear those loud cheers again. Head again stood leg-side of the ball, which is why he couldn't get bat on ball. Great contest between the bowler and the batter there. And the camera pans to Virat Kohli who obviously celebrates more aggressively than the bowler. He is everywhere, isn't he? B1$

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Josh Hazlewood to Abhishek Sharma, no run, short of length delivery, Abhishek picks out the man at point

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Josh Hazlewood to Abhishek Sharma, 1 run, uppish this time and it just lands in front of backward point, they take a run

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Josh Hazlewood to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, pushed away to the off-side and he's away

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Josh Hazlewood to Abhishek Sharma, no run, wide yorker outside off stump, Abhishek tries to squeeze it and misses

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Josh Hazlewood to Abhishek Sharma, B0$, oh the slower ball bumper, Abhishek tries to ramp it over the keeper but misses. Called wide for height and RCB don't want to waste a challenge

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU
Commentary_Text: Josh Hazlewood to Abhishek Sharma, 3 runs, oh sloppy from the RCB skipper. Abhishek Sharma pulled this shortish delivery with difficulty over mid-wicket. DDP mops up in the deep and hurls the throw towards the bowler's end. Easy two. Hoff lets this throw to be backed up by Venky Iyer who had it covered at cover. But Rajat suddenly ran in front of him from mid-off to force a fumble

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS ROYAL CHALLENGERS BENGALURU

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Abhishek Sharma, B0$ Caught by Dhruv Jurel!! Archer strikes! Nothing is as certain in the world as death, taxes, and Jofra Archer striking in the first over. This is a massive blow for SRH's chase. Abhishek was one of the architects in that 228 chase. But he's gone for a duck today. B1$

Match_Name: SUNRISERS HYDERABAD VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Ishan Kishan, B0$ Caught by Donovan Ferreira!! Archer wins the battle. No celebration from him. Just a shake of the head. But Ferreira and rest of the Rajasthan Royals are pumped. Kavya Maran, the SRH owner, has an expression of was it needed. Ishan was bossing Archer but he keeps going and perishes in the process. Back of length delivery, pounded into the surface and it gets big on Ishan who tries to flat-bat it over the off-side, the ball hits the splice and lobs to extra cover where Ferreira takes a simple catch. Just a cameo from Ishan and he's on his way back. B1$

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Nandre Burger to Shubman Gill, B0$, there's no stopping Gill today. Slower ball bowled into the wicket, he waits for the ball to arrive and shovels the pull in front of square. Mid-wicket was inside the ring and the ball races away. He's into the 90s

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Shubman Gill, B0$, he's toying with the bowling and field placement. Wherever he hits the ball seems to be going in the gap. Another slower ball from Brijesh, but the length is short and Gill hammers the pull in front of square, splitting deep mid-wicket and long-on

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Shubman Gill, B0$, bouncer around off, Gill does not even duck as the ball sails over him. Wide called for height

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Shubman Gill, 1 run, slower ball outside off, Gill chops it towards backward point and crosses over

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Brijesh Sharma to Sai Sudharsan, B0$ Hit Wkt!! Would you believe it! Twice in two games Sudharsan is out hit-wicket. The crowd are stunned. Gill sinks to his knees. "Where is the fevicol? Where is the glue?" asks Ravi Shastri on air. This is just incredible. Low full toss outside off, Sudharsan opens the bat face and slices it behind square on the off-side. The ball races away to the fence just like it did in the previous game, but it is the bat - today it does not bounce or spin onto the stumps, it B1$. That seems to be an issue with Sudharsan - even in the RCB game the bat slipped out of his grip when he opened the bat face to play the shot and today too. Nonetheless, Rajasthan Royals have finally managed to break this partnership but it might be too late. B2$

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS

There couldn't have been a better time for Gill to play such an innings. He takes off his helmet, raises his hands and soaks in the applause. Buttler embraces him in a hug. And Gill does his typical bow down celebration. Coming to the ball: Gill comes down the track, gives himself room and lofts it inside out over extra cover. He's been so good with that shot today..

Match_Name: GUJARAT TITANS VS RAJASTHAN ROYALS
Commentary_Text: Jofra Archer to Shubman Gill, B0$ Lbw!! Archer strikes! Why was he held back so long? Should he have been brought back earlier? That is all in hindsight now. Full and attacking the stumps, Gill goes deep in the crease and clears his front leg to heave across the line, misses and is struck right in-line with the stumps. Archer does not even appeal as he goes off on a frustrated celebrappeal. A magnificent knock comes to an end and Gill walks off to a standing ovation. He did not put a foot wrong today and was in complete control right through. Unfortunately he won't be there to take his side over the line but he's put them on the brink of reaching another home final. B1$

Gill wears a disappointed look
